content_preview: 【东海证券：预计10月美联储暂停加息】当地时间10月14日，美国劳工局公布2026年9月美国CPI数据。东海证券表示，9月美国CPI超预期。非核心通胀方面，9月油价大幅上涨，能源分项上涨已在预期之内，而食品价格相对稳定。核心通胀方面，受二手车和卡车、服务等带动，核心商品上涨提速，服务受住房、医疗、机票等带动，具备较强黏性。核心通胀环比超预期，且广度有所扩散，但如住房、二手车和卡车等重要分项上涨的持续性也存在不确定性。此外近期美联储官员的表态也有所分化，前瞻指引的信号模糊。预计10月美联储仍可能暂停加息，12月加息1次，2027年是否开启持续性的加息周期尚存不确定性。

title: 理想汽车筹划今年内第三次发行熊猫债
content_preview: 中国新能源车企理想汽车计划今年内第三次发行熊猫债，将公司在中国境内债市融资的规模推向新高。在业绩和股价承压之际，理想汽车正加速利用境内低成本资金充实现金储备。 彭博社星期四（10月15日）引述知情者称，理想汽车计划发行20亿元人民币（3.83亿新元）熊猫债，包括三年期和五年期，最早或于10月发行。 彭博汇总数据显示，如果完成这次发行，注册地为开曼群岛的理想汽车今年在中国境内人民币债券融资规模将达70亿元，创公司自2023年进入境内债市以来的年度新高。 这也将是理想汽车今年内第三笔熊猫债融资，公司曾在6月和8月两次发行三年期科创熊猫债。上述两只熊猫债的票面利率仅为1.75%，理想汽车在今年前两次熊猫债发行文件称，募集资金主要用于补充子公司流动资金、支持经营和研发投入等。 面对日益激烈的新能源汽车市场竞争，理想汽车业绩承压，二季度销售收入同比下滑17%。公司港股和美国ADR也接连走低，今年至今均跌约30%。 理想汽车3月宣布最高10亿美元（12.82亿新元）的股份回购计划。彭博汇总数据显示，截至9月22日，理想汽车累计回购规模已达31亿港元（5.07亿新元）。

title: 欧洲央行管委Kazaks：可以不急于采取利率行动
content_preview: 欧洲央行管理委员会成员Martins Kazaks表示，目前全球经济中的各种力量相互作用，正在影响全球通胀局势，欧洲央行有余地花一些时间来分析通胀动态。尽管石油和天然气价格的持续上涨势必会推高消费价格增速，但最近几周政府债券的抛售可能会开始对经济活动造成压力。我认为，短期内通胀压力仍将增强。因此，政策方向很明确，即使目前没有立即加息的必要。我们并未落后于形势，从这个意义上讲，我们处于有利地位。Kazaks强调，通胀上行风险“仍然大于经济增速面临的下行风险”。但经济扩张面临的威胁“可能更具非线性特征”。

title: 欧智库：出于安全考量 中国风电场以国产替代欧洲零部件
content_preview: 一家欧洲主要智库发现，出于安全和控制权等方面的考量，中国风电企业正以国产设备替换欧洲零部件。 彭博社报道，波兰官方支持的波兰东方研究中心（OSW）翻阅中国公用事业企业或其子公司自2022年以来发布的1686份公开采购文件，发现约250份文件要求，将现有风电场的外国技术替换为中国设备。 这显示中国在努力扩大风电技术及其他电网组件出口的同时，也在设法防止外部势力影响本国关键基础设施。 报道称，这个发现对欧洲影响显著。与许多其他清洁能源技术不同，欧洲企业仍是风力涡轮机的主要制造商和出口商。中国竞争对手正积极进军欧洲市场，引发了欧洲应在多大程度上向中企开放市场、容许更激烈竞争的问题。 这项调查结果出炉之际，欧盟领导人将于星期四（10月15日）举行峰会，讨论如何应对日益扩大的对华贸易逆差。 中欧上周举行新一轮贸易谈判后，双方同意中国出口欧盟的混合动力汽车减半。此前，中国混动车进口量近年来激增，欧洲汽车制造商则一直面临经营困境。 波兰东方研究中心报告也称，中国在风电领域推动技术国产替代。报告发现，拟拆除并替换的设备主要是涡轮机内的可编程电气设备，如变流器和专用晶片，以及数据管理和操作系统。 报道认为，对技术组件的关注显示，中国可能认为当下能源供应面临的风险更多来自数字系统中的关键控制环节，而非实体设施。 受影响风电场的总发电装机容量约为42.4吉瓦，超过英国的风电总装机容量，但不到中国总装机容量的6%。 采购文件涉及的欧洲风力发电企业包括维斯塔斯（Vestas）和西门子歌美飒（SGRE）等。

title: ‘We’re done’: Zelensky says Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian oil refineries
content_preview: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian oil refineries. “The block [on attacking refineries] is out. We’re done,” Ukraine’s president said in an interview with the Financial Times. He said Ukraine had not struck energy facilities in Russia for three days, in keeping with a request from the United States. Moscow, meanwhile, continued striking Ukrainian energy infrastructure, killing more than 100 civilians over the past week. Zelensky said that although Ukraine stopped striking oil refineries, it received no American warnings about Russian ballistic missile attacks. He also said Starlink terminal operations had been restricted . He confirmed that American officials had warned Ukraine that if Kyiv did not stop striking oil refineries, the United States would stop sharing intelligence. Zelensky also rejected the idea that a malfunction had caused the Starlink problems. “It was not a technical problem, it was the will,” he said. Asked whether Ukraine could stop striking oil refineries to improve relations with Washington, even if Russia continued its own attacks, Zelensky said he could agree to that in exchange for additional shipments of missiles for Patriot systems. That, he said, was the “minimum” he had asked for. Donald Trump said October 11 that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to a truce in the energy sector. Zelensky soon said the Ukrainian Armed Forces had “received all relevant orders” in connection with the truce. Ukraine then stopped striking Russian oil refineries, while Russia’s Defense Ministry reported that Russian forces had struck communications and energy infrastructure in Kyiv. According to Axios , Trump is counting on Zelensky to observe the energy truce and stop striking Russian oil refineries. “Trump is really mad. He feels Zelensky is taking the U.S. for granted,” a White House source told the outlet. At Meduza, we are committed to transparency about our use of artificial intelligence in the newsroom. title: FEDS Paper: A Macroeconomic Analysis of Household Labor Supply Responses to Large Fiscal Transfers
content_preview: Isabel Cairó , Shigeru Fujita, and Camilo Morales-Jimenez The fiscal transfers deployed during the COVID-19 pandemic were unprecedented in scale and strongly progressive. Using CPS/ASEC data, we document that the decline in employment during the pandemic was larger for low-income households and tightly linked to the intensity of transfer receipt, a pattern absent during the Global Financial Crisis. We develop and estimate a two-sector, heterogeneous-household general equilibrium model in which low-income households are borrowing-constrained in normal times but can save out of sufficiently large transfers. Because preferences permit wealth effects on labor supply, transfers both reduce labor supply and raise consumption, and a dollar of transfers is split roughly evenly between the two margins. We find that the effects of transfers are state-dependent: because the borrowing constraint binds more tightly in a deeper recession, the same transfer relaxes a tighter constraint and delivers an employment and consumption response about 40 to 50 percent larger during the pandemic than when the same transfer is introduced in the steady state. In the model, transfers were welfare-improving for recipients, with gains diminishing as transfers increase.

title: FT: U.S. proposed unfreezing some Russian assets and placing them under Washington’s control; Europe rejected the plan
content_preview: The United States has proposed that European countries unfreeze part of the Russian assets frozen since the start of Russia’s full-scale war against Ukraine and hand them over to a structure controlled by Washington, four sources told the Financial Times. American negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner put forward the proposal during talks in Miami on October 9 with representatives of Ukraine, France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the European Union, and NATO. The outlet’s sources said the fate of the frozen Russian assets was discussed as part of a comprehensive peace agreement. title: 欧洲央行卡扎克斯：多重经济力量相互博弈，欧央行无需仓促行动
content_preview: 欧洲央行管理委员会委员马丁斯·卡扎克斯表示，全球经济内部存在相互对冲的力量，在此背景下，欧洲央行可以从容分析通胀动态。这位拉脱维亚央行行长在采访中称，油价与天然气价格持续上涨将推高居民消费价格，但近几周国债抛售潮或将开始拖累经济活动。卡扎克斯正在曼谷出席国际货币基金组织年会，他表示：“我的判断是，短期通胀上行压力仍会更强。因此政策方向是明确的，尽管当下没有立刻加息的紧迫性。我们并未落后于形势，从这点看，我们处于有利位置。”（新浪财经）

title: 美官员称军方考虑用“炸弹之母”打击伊朗核设施
content_preview: 美国有线电视新闻网15日凌晨援引多名美国官员的消息报道称，美军方已制定打击伊朗的新方案，其中包括考虑使用有“炸弹之母”之称的大型空爆炸弹打击伊朗核设施。 报道援引消息人士的话称，尽管美国总统特朗普此前曾表示不会在国会中期选举前对伊朗发动攻击，但他已下令军方制定打击伊朗的新方案，目标包括伊朗“大量能源基础设施”以及拟使用“炸弹之母”打击的伊朗核设施。 据报道，“炸弹之母”是美方在伊拉克战争期间研制的一种大型空爆炸弹，可在落地前爆炸，目前是美国军方威力最大的非核炸弹之一。“炸弹之母”当初被设计为一种用于“心理战”的武器，美军希望其巨大的爆炸能震慑伊拉克军队，迫使他们投降或放弃战斗。（新华社）

title: Axios: White House denies role in Starlink restrictions in Ukraine
content_preview: A senior official in the U.S. presidential administration told Axios the White House had nothing to do with restricting Starlink’s operation in Ukraine. Axios’s sources said the Trump administration plans to contact SpaceX to find out what happened with Starlink in Ukraine. Ukraine’s Defense Ministry earlier announced that it had run into restrictions on Starshield, the military version of Starlink used by Ukrainian forces. Ukrainian servicemen and officials said the restrictions disrupted some missions. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced that U.S. authorities own and control the Starshield systems. “Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS,” he wrote on the social media platform X. The White House has not officially commented on the reports of restrictions on Starlink’s operation in Ukraine. The restriction on Starlink’s operation was reported amid a crisis in relations between U.S. President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Ukraine also said it had stopped receiving warnings from American allies about the launch of Russian ballistic missiles. Western media, citing government sources, reported that the U.S. told Ukraine it would withhold intelligence sharing unless Kyiv stopped striking Russian oil refineries. cn_summary: 美国总统府的一位高级官员向Axios透露，白宫与限制星链（Starlink）在乌克兰的运营没有任何关系。Axios的消息来源称，特朗普政府计划联系太空探索技术公司（SpaceX），以查明星链在乌克兰遭遇的具体情况。此前，乌克兰国防部曾宣布，乌军使用的军用版星链衍生系统Starshield遇到了使用限制。乌克兰军人及官员表示，这些限制打乱了部分军事行动。

title: A major Russian business association has proposed sweeping away tax breaks for small businesses. Here’s what would change — and why the Kremlin might agree.
content_preview: What happened? Delovaya Rossiya, one of Russia’s largest and most influential business associations, has proposed more than 50 economic reforms to the authorities, RBC reported . Many clearly run counter to small businesses’ interests. The association wants to scrap tax regimes that benefit small businesses and sole proprietors, bar regional governments from lowering taxes at their discretion, eliminate the patent tax system, and tax gifts and inheritances. The organization proposes eliminating the “income” option under the simplified tax system (USN) and the automated simplified tax system (AvtoUSN) as early as 2027. Businesses using these options pay tax on their total revenue at a rate of 6% under USN or 8% under AvtoUSN. Yevgeniya Memruk, head of the Union of Accountants and Tax Consultants, told RBC that these options are used by smaller businesses with high profit margins — meaning their expenses are low relative to their income — and revenues of 10 million to 20 million rubles. Their success depends largely on their owners’ labor and expertise. Switching to other tax regimes would leave them with a tax base at least two and a half times as large, making many businesses unprofitable and forcing them to close, she warned. Another proposal would set a uniform revenue threshold for value-added tax (VAT) across all special tax regimes, including AvtoUSN, starting that same year. Businesses would have to pay VAT if their revenue exceeded 20 million rubles in the previous calendar year. Under AvtoUSN, businesses can still avoid paying VAT up to a threshold of 60 million rubles. This has already prompted a mass shift to that system: Sberbank said early this year, for example, that the number of its individual entrepreneur and corporate clients using AvtoUSN had jumped sixfold in a single month — just as the threshold for businesses using “regular” USN was lowered to 20 million rubles. content_preview: （北京/丹东/首尔综合讯）连接中国辽宁省丹东市与朝鲜平安北道新义州市的新鸭绿江大桥星期四（10月15日）开通。中国总理李强发表视频致辞说，大桥将成为“象征中朝传统友谊的新地标”。 据新华社报道，李强在大桥开通仪式上通过视频连线致辞说，在双方共同努力下，大桥顺利开通，不仅将有力促进两国经贸合作，也将进一步密切双方人员往来、拉紧两国人民之间的感情纽带。 李强说，中朝关系“正在进入新阶段、开启新篇章”，希望双方以大桥开通为契机，持续优化口岸通关，提升互联互通水平，挖掘边境地区合作潜力，不断增进两国人民福祉。 据新华社报道，朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成也发表了视频致辞，但至截稿时，朝鲜官媒尚未对此次活动进行报道。 全长3026米的新鸭绿江大桥主桥在2014年竣工，但由于朝鲜一侧缺乏配套的连接公路和海关设施，开通时间被推迟，直至12年后才举行开通仪式。 综合法新社与路透社消息，展示着中朝两国国旗的卡车星期四开始双向通行，驶过新鸭绿江大桥，一些朝鲜车辆上还装饰着鲜花。在中国一侧，数百人聚集在大桥前自拍留念。 丹东居民对大桥的开放表示欢迎。一名谢姓（译音）居民说，大桥开通后，当地会变得更加热闹，也能吸引更多的游客。另一名居民说，大桥开通“对（当地）生意肯定大有裨益”。 丹东作为通往朝鲜的主要贸易门户，本世纪初曾经历过经济的繁荣，大桥延迟开通时间，对当地来说是一次打击。 韩国庆南大学远东问题研究所的林乙哲认为，这座大桥将有助于运输朝鲜在发展过程中所需的重型设备、原材料及能源产品，但不太可能促使中朝贸易立即全面恢复至2017年联合国收紧制裁前的水平。 据韩联社消息，韩国统一部负责人星期四称，大桥的开通实际上是朝中首次落实双方领导人6月达成的共识，韩国政府正密切关注朝中是否将采取务实举措，将双边关系提升至战略关系的高度。（视频来源：法新社）

title: 多款美元存款产品利率突破4%，部分银行长短期限美元存款利率出现倒挂现象
content_preview: 记者注意到，近期多家银行跟进上调美元存款利率。10月14日，每经记者走访上海地区多家银行发现，多款美元存款产品利率突破4%，部分银行长短期限美元存款利率出现倒挂现象。 天府立言金融研究院院长曾刚分析称，美元存款利率走高，首先源于美元无风险利率中枢上移，此外还与银行自身跨境结算等需求以及人民币存款利率走低有关。他提醒，若投资者单纯追逐高息应谨慎决策，需注意换汇以及汇率波动风险。（每经）

impact: 美元存款利率走高叠加期限倒挂，反映国内人民币资产收益率下行，居民跨境资产配置的汇率风险上升。
graduate_impact: 金融机构涉外资产与合规风控岗位需求因汇率波动而保持存在，但对无资产积累的毕业生而言，直接就业机会未见显著扩容。

dims.accumulation_node: 全球流动性分化驱使资本跨国寻租，国内金融资本面临资产荒压力。
dims.spatial_layer: 资金跨境流动加剧，一二线城市涉外金融业务的资源配置集聚度维持高位。
dims.state_market_shift: 央行利率调控与商业银行市场化揽储博弈，资本项目管制下边界依然清晰。

title: 魏哲家：台积电派考察团赴得州评估设厂事宜
content_preview: 台湾“护国神山”台积电董事长魏哲家说，公司已派出考察团赴得克萨斯州评估设厂事宜。 综合ETtoday财经云和网媒“科技新报”等台媒报道，魏哲家星期四（10月15日）在台积电发说会上证实，公司计划扩大在美国的布局，除现有的亚利桑那州外，也计划在得州设厂，并已派遣考察人员赴当地评估相关事宜。 他指出，台积电正积极寻求扩大美国产能，因大型客户大多在美国，且持续要求公司增加当地晶圆产能。加上有美国政府提供协助，公司近期也开始寻找美国其他扩差地点，得州是目前考虑选项之一，派人员前去考察并不代表设厂计划已定案。最终是否在得州设厂，仍有待评估结果。 对于市场关注的台积电与美国电动车巨企特斯拉首席执行官马斯克的Terafab合作，魏哲家说，台积电确实正与一名计划自行兴建晶圆厂的客户洽谈，评估能否运用相关产能，但目前没有具体结论，待合作方案确定后才会对外说明。 至于双方的合作方式，魏哲家说，各种合作架构都有讨论空间，但晶圆厂必须由台积电负责营运。 彭博社前专栏作家、独立媒体Culpium创办人高灿鸣（Tim Culpan）本月初引述知情人士称，台积电正探索与马斯克的Terafab合作，协助这家晶片初创制造商在得克萨斯州运营新的半导体工厂。 知情者称，双方合作方式尚未定案，但最可能的方案是由台积电持有并营运新厂，SpaceX/Terafab则入股、承诺采购；或由后者持有多数股权，台积电投入较少资金，提供技术和营运经验。 马斯克当时证实与台积电探索合作，之后他旗下公司负责建造和运营Terafab，台积电只是租用Terafab的一部分。

cn_title: 印度尼西亚央行行长表示通货膨胀率仍维持在目标区间内
cn_summary: 印度尼西亚央行行长指出，目前该国的通货膨胀率依然保持在中央银行设定的容忍区间之内。这一表态显示出印尼货币当局对当前宏观经济和物价水平的有效调控与信心。在面临全球经济波动和供应链压力的背景下，印尼维持了相对稳定的国内价格环境。稳健的通胀预期有助于支持当地经济的持续复苏和金融市场的稳定。印尼央行将继续密切监控国内外经济指标，以灵活调整货币政策。
impact: 印尼作为中国在东盟的重要贸易伙伴，其宏观经济和物价稳定有助于双边经贸合作的持续深化，对中国宏观经济的外部环境形成利好。这为稳定区域供应链提供了基础，进而保障了相关外贸企业的生产经营稳定。对于就业市场而言，中印尼经贸合作的稳健发展将持续释放优质岗位，为青年毕业生提供更多赴东南亚就业或从事跨境贸易的发展机遇。

title: Russian drones pound Ukraine’s Kirovohrad region for over 10 hours, killing three, emergency officials say
content_preview: Russian forces struck Ukraine’s Kirovohrad region with drones in an attack that lasted more than 10 hours, Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said. In Kropyvnytskyi, the region’s administrative center, strikes hit the grounds of businesses, logistics centers, and warehouses, as well as residential buildings. Drones also struck transportation infrastructure in the Kropyvnytskyi and Novoukrainka districts. The attack killed three people and wounded six others, according to the latest data. graduate_impact: 地缘冲突长期化导致海外供应链服务岗位萎缩，国内涉乌物流与工程类毕业生的海外派驻机会趋向归零。

cn_summary: 乌克兰国家紧急服务局表示，俄罗斯军队使用无人机对乌克兰基洛夫格勒州发动了持续10个多小时的猛烈袭击。在地区行政中心克罗皮夫尼茨基，袭击击中了企业、物流中心和仓库的场地以及居民楼。无人机还击中了克罗皮夫尼茨基和新乌克兰卡地区的交通基础设施。根据最新数据，此次袭击已造成3人死亡、6人受伤。这场持续时间较长的空袭再次凸显了乌克兰基础设施面临的严峻安全威胁。

content_preview: 【独家丨极核京东商城新国标电动自行车集体下架，20余张CCC证书被暂停或撤销】新浪科技独家获悉，近日，春风动力旗下极核电动车因大批量新国标强制性产品认证（下称：CCC）‌暂停等情况，面临无法正常售卖或上牌的情况。在京东商城线上渠道，目前所有极核新国标电动自行车已于近期下线停售。据多家极核线下门店负责人对《BUG》栏目介绍，“由于极核电动自行车CCC证书‘过期’，近一个月所有电动自行车均已无法正常上牌，线上渠道也已于四天前下线（10月10日）。”新浪科技通过国家市场监督管理总局了解到，就在10月9日——极核线上渠道电自大规模下线前一天，有20余张极核电动车CCC证书被暂停或撤销，其中多数被暂停证书仅发放约一个月，暂停时间为3个月。（新浪科技）

cn_title: 在所谓“能源停火”失效后，乌克兰将恢复对俄罗斯炼油厂的打击
cn_summary: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在接受《金融时报》采访时表示，由于俄罗斯在美总统特朗普声称达成“能源停火”后，依然持续袭击乌克兰能源基础设施并导致平民伤亡，乌方决定恢复对俄罗斯炼油厂的无人机空袭。泽连斯基透露，他此前曾下令暂停对俄炼油厂袭击三天以配合美国意愿，但俄方的持续打击令该协议破裂。这一局势表明俄乌能源战再度升级，短期内和平谈判难度加大。国际能源市场将继续因地缘冲突面临剧烈价格波动风险。
impact: 俄乌冲突导致的能源供应链紧张可能推高国际油价，进而对中国宏观经济的输入性通胀压力产生负面影响。这会增加下游制造企业的运营成本，间接对就业市场的岗位扩张产生一定抑制作用。对青年毕业生尤其是能源、化工和国际贸易方向的求职者而言，需密切防范因外部供应链动荡带来的行业周期性波动。

title: 瑞芯微：预计前三季度净利同比增长68%-73% AIoT(端侧AI)芯片产品线保持高速增长

cn_title: “新西伯利亚”号核动力潜艇在演习期间发射“缟玛瑙”与“口径”导弹
cn_summary: 俄罗斯“新西伯利亚”号核动力潜艇在近期举行的军事演习中成功进行了导弹试射。演习期间，该潜艇发射了“缟玛瑙”超音速反舰导弹以及“口径”巡航导弹。其中，“口径”导弹成功击中了位于堪察加半岛库拉靶场的预定目标。此次试射跨越了超过1200公里的距离，充分展示了该型潜艇的远程精确打击能力。演习检验了俄海军水下战略核力量与常规打击力量的实战协同水平。
impact: 该事件属于地缘政治和军事安全领域动态，对中国宏观经济的直接影响较小。然而，持续紧张的全球地缘政治局势可能通过大宗商品价格波动和国际供应链安全间接影响中国经济。在当前复杂的国际环境下，中国需进一步强化自身的国防安全与产业链供应链韧性。对国内就业市场和青年毕业生而言，高端装备制造、国防科技及相关安全领域的研发岗位可能会迎来更多政策支持与发展机遇。

title: Greenpeace reports another huge oil slick in the Black Sea following an attack on a tanker off Sochi’s coastline. Russia denies any pollution but has declared a h alert.
content_preview: A cordoned-off pier on the Black Sea coast in Sochi, October 8, 2026 Krasnodar Krai is on heightened alert over a “possible spill of petroleum products.” Governor Veniamin Kondratyev signed the order on the evening of October 13. The document says naval drone attacks on vessels in the Black Sea “caused accidents,” creating a risk of an emergency in Gelendzhik and Novorossiysk. On October 6, the Liberian-flagged oil tanker Aframax Rio caught fire off Sochi’s coast. A column of smoke was visible for kilometers, and the smell of burning reached central Sochi. Russia’s Transport Ministry said uncrewed boats (naval drones) had attacked the tanker. The 23 crew members were evacuated. Preliminary reports indicated that the tanker was carrying crude oil from Novorossiysk to India. According to another account, it was sailing empty from Turkey and was scheduled to load cargo in Novorossiysk on October 22–23. Authorities said the tanker fire had caused no pollution in the Black Sea. Russia’s consumer protection and public health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, and Sochi Mayor Andrey Proshunin were among those who said so on October 7. The Kremlin said : “The response to the incident is going well.” Even so, authorities imposed “swimming restrictions” at Sochi’s beaches. Greenpeace environmental experts said an oil slick covered about 25 square kilometers (10 square miles) of the Black Sea. Satellite images showed that during the day on October 7, the attacked tanker was near the settlement of Lazarevskoye, roughly 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the site of the fire. At that point, the experts spotted a trail of petroleum products on the water, covering about 8 square kilometers (3 square miles). Daytime satellite images from October 8 showed that the vessel had passed Tuapse and that the oil slick had grown to 25 square kilometers (10 square miles). Pollution off Krasnodar Krai’s coast has spread as far as Anapa , according to the environmental project Prozrachny Mir, citing satell

title: 南澳大桥事故致三死 广东省安委会挂牌督办
content_preview: 中国广东省汕头市南澳大桥10月5日发生一起致命交通事故，广东省安全生产委员会对事故调查处理工作挂牌督办。 综合澎湃新闻、红星新闻等报道，广东省应急管理厅网站星期三（10月14日）发布相关文件。按照要求，汕头市应迅速成立事故调查组，抓紧组织开展事故调查处理工作，并及时协调纪委监委同步成立追责问责调查组，依法追究相关单位和人员的责任。 调查组也应在事故发生后七日内提交初步调查报告，并每15日向广东省安委办报告一次该起事故调查处理工作进展情况。 有网民10月5日反映，南澳大桥上发生车祸，一辆私家车与公交车相撞，造成道路交通拥堵。行车记录仪视频显示，公交车以每小时56公里的速度在大桥上行驶，中午12时39分左右，一辆黑色小车突然越过双黄线，两车车头相撞。 现场视频显示，公交车车头破损，车上还有乘客，而小车车头则严重变形。 据南澳县交警大队工作人员介绍，肇事车辆是一辆持有临时车牌的新能源新车。至于该车为何突然失控冲向对向车道，南澳县交警大队当时称，事故原因仍在调查中。

title: 【京基智农签署算力战略合作协议 布局算力基础设施与AI场景生态建设】金十数据10月15日讯，10月15日，京基智农与超级
content_preview: 【京基智农签署算力战略合作协议 布局算力基础设施与AI场景生态建设】金十数据10月15日讯，10月15日，京基智农与超级智算公司在深圳签署《战略合作协议》。作为战略合作的落地首步，公司算力业务子公司子夏北方与超级智算公司签署购销合同，采购AI服务器产品，本次采购是进一步扩充算力资源。合作内容涵盖算力基础设施与产品、供应链与生产协同、全生命周期运营、市场拓展与生态共建四个方面：双方将建立供应保障机制，在设备选型、质量验证、交付验收等环节协同联动；利用各自展示中心与客户资源开展联合市场推广，面向政务、金融等通用算力市场，并在智慧园区、智慧酒店、智慧农业、食品冷链与安全追溯等场景推动应用落地，形成“算力-场景-服务”产业生态。

title: 华为半导体黄宇：韬定律最大挑战在于EDA工具
content_preview: 10月15日，在2026湾芯展上，华为半导体EDA首席科学家黄宇表示，华为的韬定律主要分四层：最基础的器件层，优化晶体管结构和互联方式，从源头压缩器件时间常数；第二层是链路层，这是华为最大的创新点；第三层是芯片层，软硬件协同设计，形成新架构；第四层是系统层，即大家熟知的超级节点、机柜互联，需要更好的通讯协议和更快的速度。 黄宇表示，韬定律最大挑战在于EDA工具。同时，工艺挑战、工程挑战和系统设计挑战也都存在。（上证报）

cn_title: 胡塞武装否认参与针对麦地那的导弹发射
cn_summary: 胡塞武装军事发言人叶海亚·萨雷亚发表声明称，沙特方面关于胡塞武装向麦地那发动袭击的指控是“彻头彻尾的谎言”。这一否认再次凸显了中东地区各方在信息战和军事指控上的对立态势。近期该地区的导弹和无人机袭击事件频发，加剧了沙特等国与胡塞武装之间的信任赤字。地区安全形势依然错综复杂，任何误判都可能引发更广泛的冲突。国际社会正密切关注该地区军事动态的发展。
impact: 中东地缘政治矛盾的尖锐化对全球金融市场风险偏好产生扰动，中国宏观经济政策需持续应对外部输入性风险。就业市场上，由于涉中东业务的跨国企业面临较高安全合规成本，相关领域的商务和工程岗位招聘可能趋于谨慎，对追求海外发展机遇的青年毕业生带来一定的观望情绪。

title: FSB says it detained a Swedish citizen in Russia, accuses him of fighting for Ukraine and plotting sabotage
content_preview: Russia’s Federal Security Service says it detained a Swedish citizen in the Pskov region, alleging he fought on the side of Ukraine’s armed forces in the Russia–Ukraine war. The FSB said in a statement that he had traveled to Russia “under the guise of joining the Russian Armed Forces” to carry out sabotage at military facilities. The FSB said the Swedish citizen served from February to June 2026 as commander of an unmanned aerial systems squad in the 24th Separate Assault Battalion, an organization Russia has designated as a terrorist organization. “There are documents confirming his participation in combat operations against our country as part of Ukraine’s armed forces,” the agency said. The FSB has not disclosed his name. Russian authorities have opened a criminal case against him for illegally crossing the Russian border, and the FSB plans to open a second case charging him with organizing the activities of a terrorist organization and mercenarism. On October 13, the FSB said it had detained Yuki Imai, a Japanese citizen and correspondent for the newspaper Hokkaido Shimbun, in Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk on espionage charges. The agency claimed the journalist, acting on assignment from Japanese intelligence, had been gathering data on how many Kuril Islands residents had been mobilized or volunteered to fight in the war in Ukraine. cn_title: 俄罗斯联邦安全局称在俄拘留一名瑞典公民，指控其为乌克兰作战并策划破坏活动
cn_summary: 俄罗斯联邦安全局宣布在普斯科夫地区拘留了一名瑞典公民。俄方指控该男子曾在俄乌冲突中加入乌克兰武装部队作战。根据安全局的声明，他伪装成加入俄军的志愿者潜入俄罗斯，企图对军事设施实施破坏。经调查，该瑞典公民曾于2026年2月至6月期间，担任乌克兰第24独立突击营无人机部队的分队长。目前相关案件正在进一步侦办中，该事件凸显了当前地缘政治冲突的持续紧张。
impact: 该事件加剧了俄罗斯与西方国家之间的地缘政治紧张局势，对中国宏观经济的直接影响有限。然而，持续升级的国际冲突可能通过大宗商品价格波动和全球供应链风险间接传导至国内。对就业市场和青年毕业生而言，海外安全风险的增加提醒相关跨国企业和海外务工人员需高度重视地缘政治风险，相关涉外法务、国际安保等领域的专业人才需求或将受到关注。

title: 中国宣布整治网络涉军不当营销和炒作信息
content_preview: 中国官方宣布展开为期两个月的网络涉军不当营销和炒作信息专项整治。 中共中央网信办、中国退役军人事务部、中央军委政治工作部，以及中央军委政法委员会发布通知，宣布从10月份开始集中开展上述专项整治。 根据中国网信网星期四（10月15日）发布的这份通知，这个专项整治的工作目标是集中筛查处置一批打着退役军人、军属等旗号违规开展涉军不当营销和炒作、误导社会公众认知的网站账号，曝光一批典型案例。 这份通知提到，专项整治期间，主要筛查处置以下10类开展网络涉军不当营销和散布涉军炒作信息的网站账号，包装所谓“内部考试名额”、“免试入职”、“军考保过”等，发布涉及士兵考学提干、直接选拔招录军官、军队文职人员招考、退役安置辅导培训等虚假营销信息。 其他筛查处置目标还包括，片面或者错误解读军队人员晋升任用、选调交流、退役退出、福利待遇等政策，以提供付费咨询、组建粉丝群组等形式不当牟利；利用军队退役专家、军队名人身份或者关联相关书画、演出等活动，开展违规营销宣传、炒作涉军信息；使用涉军特定含义字样和图案、部队履历敏感信息等开展网络营销活动。 此外，关联炒作涉及军队院校招生、部队征兵等负面信息，恶意发布唱衰军事职业发展等信息；关联退役军人或者军队人员家属等身份，讨论散布服役经历、营区定位、部队番号、训练装备、军事行动等敏感信息，也是这项整治行动的主要筛查处置目标。

title: 深圳APEC会议期间 倡企业灵活安排员工上班
content_preview: 中国深圳将在下个月举行亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议，当地官方星期四（10月15日）称，倡导企业根据生产、工作的具体情况及所在区域，在APEC会议当周工作日期间实行灵活工作安排。 据《南方都市报》报道，深圳市政府新闻办星期四举行新闻发布会，介绍APEC会议期间交通组织保障和城市运行相关安排情况。深圳市人力资源保障局副局长郝时飞在会上说，深圳倡导企业根据生产、工作的具体情况及所在区域，在APEC会议当周工作日期间，即11月16日至20日，实行灵活工作安排。 郝时飞说，灵活工作安排包括居家远程办公、错峰上下班、弹性上下班、休带薪年休假等多种方式。企业可在与职工充分协商的基础上，结合实际因企施策、因岗施策、因时施策、因地施策，不同企业、同一企业的不同岗位，均可选择不同的方式。 APEC工商领导人峰会将于11月17日至18日在深圳举行，随后是11月18日至19日的领导人峰会。届时，包括美国、俄罗斯、日本和韩国在内的21个经济体将聚首讨论区域经济合作和贸易议题。 此前，深圳市教育局10月9日在微信公众号宣布，全市中小学将在11月17日至20日放秋假。

title: Ukraine detains Russian soldier after five Ukrainian troops shot dead in Kharkiv region
content_preview: Update: The Security Service of Ukraine confirmed that the man who attacked the Ukrainian soldiers has been detained. He is a 36-year-old Russian soldier from St. Petersburg who was previously convicted in Russia. The agency did not specify whether he was a prisoner of war. Five soldiers from the Ukrainian Armed Forces’ 72nd Separate Mechanized Brigade were shot dead on October 13 in the village of Kutuzivka in the Kharkiv region. According to Ukraine’s Military Law Enforcement Service, which polices the armed forces, “a man in civilian clothes armed with an automatic weapon” opened fire. The motive remains unknown. The service said the slain soldiers had gotten along well with their comrades and had no disciplinary problems. The news outlet Hlavkom reported that police are searching for two Russian soldiers in connection with the killings. Both had escaped captivity. Law enforcement sources told Suspilne that the gunman had already been detained in a district of Kharkiv. Police and prosecutors have not yet confirmed that account. Ukrainian law enforcement authorities are considering several possible explanations for the attack and have not ruled out Russian soldiers’ involvement. cn_title: 报道称安德松未能赢得瑞典首相首轮投票
cn_summary: 相关报道显示，安德松在瑞典首相选举的第一轮投票中未能获得足够的支持票。这一结果反映出当地政坛复杂的党派博弈以及组阁过程中的重重阻力。各政党之间在关键政策和权力分配上仍存在明显的分歧。后续的政治谈判和新一轮投票将决定瑞典新政府的走向。这也给该国的政治稳定和未来的政策实施带来了不确定性。
impact: 作为欧洲内部的政治动态，瑞典首相选举波折对中国宏观经济的直接影响微乎其微。中国与瑞典之间的双边贸易和经贸合作主要受全球市场需求和企业战略指引。该事件对国内就业市场和青年毕业生求职基本没有实质性关联，相关海外政治变化一般不会波及国内的招聘形势。

title: 赣锋锂业：前三季度净利润同比增长19541% 锂系列产品售价回升及锂电池系列产品销量增加
content_preview: 【赣锋锂业：前三季度净利润同比增长19541% 锂系列产品售价回升及锂电池系列产品销量增加】财联社10月15日电，赣锋锂业(002460.SZ)公告称，前三季度实现营业收入361.59亿元，同比增长147.24%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润50.12亿元，同比增长19540.50%。第三季度营业收入130.62亿元，同比增长109.03%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润7.55亿元，同比增长35.62%。业绩增长主要系本期锂系列产品售价回升及锂电池系列产品销量增加所致。小财注：公司Q3净利润7.55亿，Q2净利润24.2亿，据此计算，Q3净利润环比下降68%。

title: 【覆盖1000余个场景，工信部发布人工智能“产业导航图”】金十数据10月15日讯，从工业和信息化部了解到，我国将以制造业
content_preview: 【覆盖1000余个场景，工信部发布人工智能“产业导航图”】金十数据10月15日讯，从工业和信息化部了解到，我国将以制造业为主战场、以应用牵引为主线，推动人工智能产业高水平赋能新型工业化。据了解，工业和信息化部已经组织近30场人工智能赋能新型工业化“深度行”活动，促成5000余家企业供需对接。支持创建北京、济南—青岛等18个国家人工智能创新应用先导区，推动产业界研制近200项人工智能关键技术标准。设立600亿元国家人工智能产业投资基金。工业和信息化部今天正式发布“人工智能赋能新型工业化高价值场景”，为人工智能赋能新型工业化提供可参考借鉴的“产业导航图”。由多家科研机构和企业共同完成的“人工智能赋能新型工业化高价值场景”覆盖石化、钢铁、汽车、消费电子等20个细分领域、1000余个场景。这些“人工智能+”应用都来自产业一线的生产制造实践。专家指出，当前，人工智能在工业领域落地转化过程中面临部分企业盲目跟风、重复建设以及成功经验迁移复用难等挑战。

cn_title: 台积电第三季度净利润创历史新高 首席执行官称未见放缓迹象
cn_summary: 全球最大半导体代工厂台积电公布了亮眼的第三季度财报，净利润达到创纪录的7,633.4亿新台币。面对全球经济的不确定性，台积电首席执行官表示，目前没有看到任何业务放缓的迹象。这一强劲表现在很大程度上受益于全球对人工智能（AI）芯片持续高涨的强劲需求。该公司的出色业绩提振了全球科技行业的信心，显示出半导体超级周期的韧性。
impact: 台积电的亮眼业绩凸显了全球人工智能和半导体产业链的高景气度，对中国宏观经济中的高技术制造业和数字经济发展具有积极的参考意义。在就业市场方面，半导体行业的扩张将持续带动相关软硬件研发、集成电路设计等高附加值岗位需求。对于国内应届毕业生而言，芯片与AI相关的高端制造领域依然提供了大量高质量的就业与发展机遇。

title: Russian telecom operator Rostelecom proposes ‘doomsday’ backup data center to restore services after attacks
content_preview: Russia needs a “doomsday” data center, said Valery Yermakov, deputy chairman of Rostelecom’s management board. He made the proposal on the day Ukrainian drones first attacked a Sber data center. Everyone understands that we absolutely need a so-called doomsday facility today. It’s a place to store backups so that if something happens, you can always restore your services. Some time ago, this really would have been unimaginable, but now there’s a very real need for it. We need a so-called doomsday data center because backups now allow any service provider to recover very quickly. Ukrainian drones attacked Sber’s infrastructure for the first time overnight into October 14, hitting a data center in Balakovo, in Russia’s Saratov region. Sber confirmed the attack but said all its services were operating normally. Users, however, began reporting disruptions to Sber and other services. title: US weighs easing sanctions on ‘shadow fleet’ tankers
content_preview: The administration of U.S. President Donald Trump is discussing a partial easing of sanctions on the “shadow fleet” of tankers that transport oil from countries such as Russia, Iran, and Venezuela, Reuters reported. The White House believes the move would lower freight rates for oil tankers, which are at record highs, allowing more oil and oil products to move out of the Persian Gulf. The move would involve partially lifting restrictions on “shadow fleet” tankers carrying “legal oil,” a government source told Reuters. Those seeking to use “shadow fleet” vessels for that purpose would need permission from the U.S. Treasury Department. The White House did not respond to Reuters’ request for comment. Experts polled by the agency said partially lifting sanctions on “shadow fleet” vessels is unlikely to lower freight rates. Insurance companies, they said, will still have to comply with EU and U.K. law, which is not expected to ease restrictions on the “shadow fleet.” Donald Trump announced on October 9 that Russia and the U.S. had agreed to the supply of Russian diesel fuel to American and global markets. U.S. sanctions on diesel from Russia have been partially lifted. At Meduza, we are committed to transparency about our use of artificial intelligence in the newsroom. cn_title: 美国考虑放松对“影子舰队”油轮的制裁
cn_summary: 据路透社报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政府正在讨论部分放松对运输俄罗斯、伊朗和委内瑞拉等国石油的“影子舰队”油轮的制裁。白宫认为，此举能够降低目前处于历史高位的油轮运费，从而允许更多的石油和石油产品流出波斯湾。该举措将涉及部分解除对运载“合法石油”的“影子舰队”油轮的限制。此政策调整若落地，将对全球国际原油贸易格局及航运市场产生深远影响。国际能源市场正在密切关注美国制裁政策的潜在转向。
impact: 美国放松对特定油轮制裁有助于缓解全球国际原油供给压力并降低运费，这间接有利于作为能源进口大国的中国降低能源采购成本，对平抑国内输入性通胀产生积极作用。在就业方面，相关航运、大宗商品贸易及能源化工行业的成本波动，可能会对部分外贸和物流企业的经营产生联动效应，但对中国高校毕业生的整体就业市场影响较为温和。

title: Russian political scientist Alexander Kynev, arrested on drug charges and reportedly beaten so badly his leg was broken in two places, faces transfer to another detention center, lawyer says
content_preview: Political scientist Alexander Kynev, who was arrested in connection with an alleged attempt to sell drugs, was due to be transferred from the Matrosskaya Tishina pretrial detention center to another detention facility on October 14, his lawyer Mikhail Biryukov said. “We don’t know why he is being transferred, on what grounds, or where he will be held,” Biryukov said. Kynev is one of the most respected experts on Russian regional politics and elections. Russian authorities have designated him a “foreign agent.” Kynev was arrested on September 25. Human rights advocates from Slovo Zashchity said he was severely beaten during his arrest. The advocates said he was diagnosed with two fractures in his shinbone. He was admitted to Matrosskaya Tishina’s hospital. According to political scientist Ekaterina Schulmann , Kynev’s leg was broken to force him to confess to treason. She did not specify where she got this information. Kynev’s defense team said it had “no documents confirming what Schulmann said.” Read more Russian elections expert Alexander Kynev stayed in the country to keep studying its politics. After criticizing the latest vote, he was arrested on drug charges. Russian state officials say ruling party United Russia won 58% in last weekend’s parliamentary election. title: 商务部部长王文涛会见美国苹果公司执行董事长蒂姆·库克
content_preview: 10月15日，商务部部长王文涛会见苹果公司执行董事长蒂姆·库克。双方就中美经贸关系、人工智能发展、苹果公司在华业务等议题进行交流。 王文涛表示，在两国元首构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系”的共识引领下，中美经贸磋商取得积极成果。中方倡导人工智能发展安全可控、普惠向善、治理合作。希望苹果公司发挥沟通桥梁作用，为推动中美经贸关系持续稳定向好发展贡献力量。当前，中国坚定不移扩大高水平对外开放，持续优化营商环境，消费市场扩容升级，绿色供应链不断壮大，将为跨国企业在华投资向智能、绿色、创新转型提供更广阔空间。希望苹果公司继续深耕中国市场，共享中国式现代化发展机遇。 库克表示，苹果公司看好中国发展前景，将进一步扩大在华业务，并愿为推动美中经贸关系稳定健康发展发挥积极作用。

title: 中国密集推稳增长措施 内需弱和地方债“拖后腿”
content_preview: 中国近期密集推出财政、货币、房地产和消费政策，力争实现全年4.5%至5%的经济增长目标。在经济增速放缓、出口面临 中欧贸易摩擦 等外部风险的背景下，提振内需的紧迫性上升。 中国上半年经济增长4.7%，第二季增速从第一季的5%放缓至4.3%。第三季及前三季经济数据预计下星期公布。国际货币基金组织（IMF）星期二（10月13日）将中国今年经济增长预测从4.6%下调至4.5%。 受访学者指出，今年是中国“十五五”（2026年至2030年）开局之年， 月底还将召开中共二十届五中全会 ，官方须争取在今年最后两个多月推动经济增长，以实现全年目标。“若第一年未能达标，后续信心可能进一步受挫。” 当前政策的关键考验在于，能否转化为居民消费和企业投资等实际需求。 财政、货币、房地产政策接连出台 中国国务院上月底召开常务会议，要求加大宏观政策逆周期调节力度，研究推出增量政策，重点涉及稳定房地产市场、促进就业和增加居民收入。 财政部10月9日宣布，安排使用5500亿元（人民币，下同，1050亿新元）地方政府债务结存限额，其中3000亿元分配给县区，以增强基层财政保障能力；2500亿元用于扩大有效投资，优先保障在建项目。这笔资金来自此前核定但尚未使用的债务限额，并非新增债务限额。 货币政策方面，中国人民银行9月29日增加科技创新、技术改造、支农支小及民营企业相关再贷款额度，并将抵押补充贷款利率从1.75%下调至1.5%。 房地产方面，中国从10月1日起实施为期一年的购房贷款贴息政策，对符合条件的首套住房商业贷款提供年化1个百分点的补贴，贷款本金上限为100万元，最长补贴五年。消费品以旧换新政策继续实施，官方也提出促进就业、增加居民收入。 这一系列措施侧重盘活现有资金、引导资源投向重点领域，并非全面、大规模的刺激。 消费疲弱 债务压力制约政策效果 中国国庆七天假期国内出游8亿2600万人次，总花费约7384亿元，但人均每次出游消费约894元，同比下降1.9%，为2022年以来同期最低。国庆档票房约11亿6000万元，同比下跌36.6%，创2014年以来同期最低水平。 野村证券分析，低线城市人口持续流出，居民对房价前景缺乏信心，房贷贴息对提振住房销售的作用可能有限。 《华尔街日报》10月12日报道，按该报引用的统计口径，中国非金融部门信贷规模在2025年超过国内生产总值（GDP）的300%，较2019年底上升约60个百分点。报道指出，资金流向需求不足的工厂和住宅项目，加剧产能过剩与价格竞争，压低企业利润和工资；企业转向出口消化过剩产能，又加剧贸易摩擦。 《金融时报》10月11日报道，地方政府债务利息支出自2014年以来年均增长约16%，中央与地方政府2026年的债务利息支出预计合计达1.4万亿元，进一步增加财政负担。 香颂资本执行董事沈萌接受《联合早报》采访时指出，地方政府收入减少、债务负担加重，确实会限制日常支出，但不能直接等同于中央政府推出全国性刺激政策的空间受限。 沈萌认为，中国经济的核心问题是供给与消费需求错配。若居民消费能力和信心不足，继续向生产端提供优惠政策只会扩大产能，却难以消化；提振内需须提高居民收入、保障就业并改善未来预期。 产业转型也面临两难。沈萌分析，硬科技与传统产业都需要政策支持，传统产业尤其承担大量就业和社会责任，不能轻易放弃，“长板要拉，短板也要拉”。 他认为，传统产业应调整产能、提高效率和增加附加值，新兴产业则须加快发展、创造增量；中国人口规模庞大、区域发展不平衡，产业转型需要时间，出口能为国内调整争取空间，贸易摩擦却增加转型难度。 新刺激力度或属中等规模 新加坡国立大学李光耀公共政策学院副教授顾清扬向本报分析，中国未来两个月仍可能推出新刺激措施，但不会采取“大水漫灌”式刺激，而是通过定向财政和货币政策兼顾增长与结构调整。他预计，新增政策力度可能属中等规模，或在中共五中全会之后出台。 谈及内需不足时，顾清扬说：“中国的需求问题不能只是从需求角度解决，而要从供给和需求双方相互作用的角度来解决消费不足的问题。” 他认为，改善营商环境、降低企业税收和社保等经营负担，有助企业扩大投资、创造就业，进而增加居民收入。人工智能应用也有助降低成本、提高效率，“把整个经济蛋糕做大了，就需要更多劳动力”。 对于地方财政，顾清扬指出，房地产低迷导致土地出让收入减少，部分地方融资平台投资回报不高也加重偿债压力；解决问题须拓展土地收入以外的财源，并重新厘清中央与地方的事权、财权。 顾清扬预计，中国今年全年经济增长至少可达4.5%，但可能不超过4.7%，较理想结果是4.6%。沈萌则认为，官方最终公布的数据可能接近5%，但即使达到5%增长，“就像去年，普通人也没有觉得经济有增长”。

title: 中方是否已同意对津巴布韦的债务进行部分重组？外交部回应
content_preview: 10月15日，外交部发言人毛宁主持例行记者会。彭博社记者提问，有报道称，津巴布韦财政部长称，中方已同意对津巴布韦的债务进行部分重组，发言人能否确认上述报道？毛宁表示，中国和津巴布韦两国传统友好，我们高度重视津巴布韦方面债务处置的诉求，双方有关部门和金融机构保持着沟通。“具体的进展你可以向中方的主管部门了解。”（澎湃新闻）

title: 李强下周访俄罗斯 举行中俄总理定期会晤
content_preview: 中国外交部星期四（10月15日）宣布，总理李强将在下星期访问俄罗斯，举行中俄总理定期会晤。访俄前，他还将访问乌兹别克斯坦和塔吉克斯坦。 中国外交部发言人星期四宣布，应乌兹别克斯坦总理阿里波夫邀请，李强将于本周末（10月17日至18日）对乌兹别克斯坦进行正式访问。 随后，应塔吉克斯坦总理拉苏尔佐达邀请，李强将于10月18日至20日对塔吉克斯坦进行正式访问并出席上海合作组织成员国政府首脑（总理）理事会会议。 接着，应俄罗斯总理米舒斯京邀请，李强将于10月20日至22日赴俄罗斯举行中俄总理定期会晤。

title: ‘We were way too patient, way too tolerant’: Latvia’s prime minister urges ‘great caution’ in dealing with independent Russian journalism and backs Leonid Ragozin’s expulsion

title: 美国通胀超预期 中国股市收于14个月新低
content_preview: 美国通胀数据高于预期，引发市场对利率可能进一步上升的担忧。中国股市星期四（10月15日）跟随全球股市普遍下跌的走势走低，科技股领跌，收于14个月以来最低水平。 截至星期四收盘，上证指数和沪深300指数分别下跌1.59%和1.23%，创下2025年8月以来的收盘新低。 路透社引述瑞银证券中国股票策略师孟磊说，近期股市回调似乎更多是由于此前科技股交易过于拥挤，相关仓位遭集中削减所致。与此同时，共同基金也面临投资者在回本后赎回基金所带来的压力。 据路透社报道，地缘政治局势、美国国债收益率及油价波动影响市场对通胀的预期，导致美元流动性趋紧，进而削弱市场风险偏好。 数据显示，美国上个月消费者价格涨幅高于预期，推动美元上涨，华尔街股市则下跌。市场也一度重新押注美联储可能加息。 德国商业银行分析师在报告中称：“隔夜市场的焦点是美国通胀数据高于预期，再度引发市场对美联储加息的担忧。” 同时，在贸易、信贷投放等一系列经济数据表现向好后，投资者正将目光转向中国下星期一（10月19日）将公布的第三季度国内生产总值（GDP）数据，以判断经济复苏的力度。

title: 民进党大咖为高雄市长参选人赖瑞隆助阵 应对国民党“韩流”
content_preview: 面对国民党高雄市长本周六的助选活动迎来“韩流”，台湾民进党高雄市长参选人赖瑞隆竞选总部成立大会将获得绿营大咖的助阵。 2018年台湾九合一地方选举，韩国瑜参选高雄市长掀起的“韩流”，迄今仍让人记忆犹新。 综合ETtoday新闻云和中时新闻网等台媒报道，国民党高雄市长参选人柯志恩星期四（10月15日）到中正市场拜票，出发前受访时说，立法院长韩国瑜将在星期六（10月17日）到高雄小港参加庙口音乐会，为她助选。 柯志恩称，消息传出后，她的办公室接到很多民众的询问电话，因此她相信“礼拜六韩院长到高雄来的时候，一定会引发爆量的人潮”。 在那之前，柯志恩星期五（10月16日）晚间在冈山的造势活动，由台中市长卢秀燕、新北市长侯友宜和身兼柯志恩竞总主委的前立法院长王金平合体站台。 赖瑞隆竞总大会将在星期六于凤山举行，原先仅公布找来前总统蔡英文和高雄市长陈其迈助讲，星期四宣布加码邀请副总统萧美琴、台日关系协会会长、前行政院长谢长廷到场辅选，全力对抗“韩流”来袭。 赖瑞隆说，蔡英文与萧美琴这次特别同台，不仅是对他的疼惜，更是对高雄未来进步发展的支持。两人都拥有深厚的涉外格局，熟悉国际局势，且深知台湾走向世界需要每座城市共同努力。此次相挺，也是对他提出“南方掘起、迈向国际”市政目标的肯定。 赖瑞隆并称，高雄的进步，是一棒接一棒、与市民共同打拼的成果。谢长廷与陈其迈将集结相挺，陪伴他承担关键第四棒。从十年市府到十年议会，他始终参与高雄的重大时刻，未来将延续历任市长奠定的基础，带领高雄再创高峰。

title: China's MIIT issues AI industry navigation map covering 1,000+ manufacturing scenarios
content_preview: China's MIIT issues AI industry navigation map covering 1,000+ manufacturing scenarios The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) published an AI-for-new-industrialization navigation map covering more than 1,000 frontline manufacturing scenarios across 20 sub-sectors, including petrochemicals, steel, autos and consumer electronics. MIIT said the document — compiled with research institutes and firms — follows nearly 30 targeted AI industrialization events that facilitated 5,000+ enterprise supply‑demand matches. The ministry is backing 18 national AI innovation application pilot zones (including Beijing and Jinan‑Qingdao), pushing development of nearly 200 AI technical standards and establishing a CNY 60 bln national AI industry investment fund. MIIT flagged implementation risks including herd-driven/duplicate investment and difficulty replicating pilot successes.

cn_title: 中国工信部发布覆盖千余个制造场景的AI产业导航图
cn_summary: 中国工业和信息化部正式发布了“人工智能赋能新型工业化”产业导航图。该导航图涵盖了石化、钢铁、汽车和消费电子等20个细分行业的1000多个一线制造场景。工信部表示，该文件由相关研究机构与企业共同编制，此前已通过近30场针对性的AI产业化对接活动促成了5000多项合作。此举旨在深化人工智能与实体经济的融合，推动制造业高端化、智能化发展。标志着中国在推进新型工业化进程中迈出了关键的场景落地步伐。
impact: 工信部发布的AI制造导航图对中国宏观经济的高质量发展具有重要推动作用，有助于加速传统产业转型升级和新质生产力培育。在就业市场方面，制造场景的智能化升级将催生大量复合型工程技术及AI应用岗位。对于青年毕业生而言，懂技术、懂制造的跨界复合型人才需求将大幅增加，为青年群体在智能制造领域的就业创造了广阔空间和高薪机遇。

title: Germany has stood by Ukraine throughout Russia’s invasion. A trial over the Nord Stream explosions could put Berlin’s unconditional support to the test.
content_preview: Serhiy Kuznetsov with his lawyers in court in Hamburg, October 14, 2026 The trial of Ukrainian national Serhiy Kuznetsov began in Hamburg on October 14. Investigators allege that he took part in the September 2022 bombing of the Nord Stream pipelines. Kuznetsov, 50, is formally charged with disrupting the operation of essential public infrastructure. Investigators allege that he coordinated the sabotage team that carried out the explosions. The indictment, reviewed by the broadcaster ZDF, says Ukrainian state agencies commissioned the sabotage. ZDF did not specify which agencies. Investigators identify Roman Chervinskyi, an officer in Ukraine’s security services, as the organizer. Prosecutors say Kuznetsov’s actions should be classified as a war crime because he was serving in the military at the time of the bombing and acted with the knowledge of the Ukrainian authorities. His defense team maintains that he had nothing to do with the incident. His lawyers say he was in Ukraine when the bombing occurred. The broadcaster ARD reported that the trial and the court’s final ruling will have significant international implications. “The mere fact that a Ukrainian citizen is appearing before a German court on charges of sabotage and other crimes is an extremely serious matter at a time when Ukraine is fighting for its survival and Germany is its biggest supporter in its fight to defend itself against Russia,” international law expert Clemens Fischer told the broadcaster. He said Germany would find it “very difficult to continue supporting Ukraine unconditionally” if the court established that the Ukrainian government was involved in the sabotage. It is unclear how long the trial will last. The court said it could not conclude the case in just a few hearings, “simply because of the volume of case files and the international aspects of the case.” Hearings are currently scheduled through January 29, 2027, averaging twice a week. cn_title: （第二版）受人工智能与通胀忧虑引发的芯片股抛售拖累，首尔股市暴跌逾7%
cn_summary: 受全球范围内对人工智能发展前景的担忧以及通货膨胀压力的双重打击，首尔股市遭遇重挫，主要股指盘中跌幅超过7%。半导体板块成为重灾区，权重股集体跳水，拖累整体大盘大幅下行。投资者对科技行业估值过高的情绪蔓延，导致市场恐慌性抛售加剧。此次股市崩盘反映出亚洲资本市场对外部宏观经济不确定性的高度敏感。这也进一步加剧了区域内金融市场的动荡局面。
impact: 韩国股市大跌和芯片板块的崩盘，短期内可能通过资本市场和全球供应链渠道对中国A股的半导体及科技板块产生情绪面上的传导。不过，这也凸显了中国加速推进关键核心技术自主可控的必要性。在外部金融波动加剧的背景下，国内资本市场的稳健运行和宏观政策调控对于稳定市场预期显得尤为重要，对青年就业的直接冲击较为有限，但相关科技产业链企业需防范外部需求波动的风险。

cn_summary: 据Apple Store天猫官方旗舰店消息，苹果双11促销活动将于10月20日启动。今年秋季刚刚上市的iPhone 18 Pro及iPhone 18 Pro Max机型可参与立减300元的天猫优惠券活动，并能叠加500元的以旧换新政府补贴。同时，上一代iPhone 17机型降价1000元，同样可享受500元的以旧换新国家补贴。抖音官方旗舰店也同步推出了相应的双11购机优惠及以旧换新补贴政策。
impact: 苹果高端手机及前代产品密集降价并叠加政府以旧换新补贴，有利于进一步激发国内消费市场活力，推动电子产品消费升级与绿色循环经济。这不仅有助于提振零售与电商行业的宏观经济表现，还带动了终端销售、物流仓储及线下回收等产业链的用工需求。对于广大青年毕业生而言，电商大促销及消费电子产业的终端促销竞争，为市场营销、供应链管理、数据分析等相关专业的求职者提供了更多就业岗位与实践机会。

title: Users start reporting outages in Sberbank services after Ukrainian drone attack on company’s data center
content_preview: The number of users reporting outages in Sberbank’s services has sharply increased in Moscow, St. Petersburg, the Novosibirsk region, and other regions, according to data from the monitoring sites Sboi.rf and Downdetector. Users reported that online banking was not working, payments were not going through, the website would not load, and the app would not open. Outages were also reported on other sites and services: Mail.ru, Kontur, Ozon, MegaFon, and VKontakte, as well as the provider SkyNet St. Petersburg. Ukrainian drones attacked a Sberbank data center in Balakovo, in the Saratov region, overnight on October 14. Sberbank First Deputy Chairman Alexander Vedyakhin confirmed the attack but said all services were operating normally. Ukraine’s armed forces struck data centers belonging to Yandex three times last week. After the third strike, users across Russia began experiencing problems with Yandex’s own services as well as those of many other websites. Yandex’s services abroad, in Armenia, Belarus, Georgia, Kazakhstan, and Serbia, also stopped working or experienced disruptions. title: 沙特遭胡塞袭击之际 欧盟与海湾国家预计将延迟利雅得峰会
content_preview: 欧盟与海湾合作委员会预计将推迟重要的政治峰会，东道主沙特阿拉伯正遭到也门胡塞武装的袭击。保加利亚总理Rumen Radev周四表示：“遗憾的是，据我所知，利雅得的这次会议将被推迟，可能是出于安全原因。”原定10月24日在利雅得举行的会议，计划由欧盟成员国和欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩，与沙特阿拉伯、巴林、科威特、阿曼、卡塔尔和阿联酋领导人共同出席。但知情人士称，一些海湾国家官员已告知欧洲方面，由于安全局势，他们很可能推迟此次会议。（彭博）

title: 极核京东商城新国标电动自行车集体下架，20余张CCC证书被暂停或撤销
content_preview: 近日，春风动力旗下极核电动车因大批量新国标强制性产品认证（下称：CCC）暂停等情况，面临无法正常售卖或上牌的情况。在京东商城线上渠道，目前所有极核新国标电动自行车已于近期下线停售。据多家极核线下门店负责人对《BUG》栏目介绍，“由于极核电动自行车CCC证书‘过期’，近一个月所有电动自行车均已无法正常上牌，线上渠道也已于四天前下线（10月10日）。”新浪科技通过国家市场监督管理总局了解到，就在10月9日——极核线上渠道电自大规模下线前一天，有20余张极核电动车CCC证书被暂停或撤销，其中多数被暂停证书仅发放约一个月，暂停时间为3个月。（新浪科技）

title: Masked intruders set fire to 11 Starlink antennas in Bulgaria
content_preview: Two masked intruders broke into a communications facility near Sofia, Bulgaria, and set fire to 11 of its 17 antennas used to communicate with Starlink satellites, Bulgarian National Television reported . The Insider determined from satellite images that the fire occurred 20 kilometers (about 12 miles) from Sofia. Bulgarian lawmaker Ivaylo Mirchev also reported the incident. He posted a video of the fire and said a similar incident occurred in Poland in September. According to Mirchev, Polish authorities have no doubt that Russia is behind the acts of sabotage. “Clearly, these antennas were deliberately targeted, since they provide the main connection to the satellites,” Mirchev said. There was no word on whether the damaged antennas were used to provide communications for Ukraine’s armed forces. On October 14, Ukraine’s armed forces said SpaceX had restricted Starlink satellite communications for the Ukrainian military. The restrictions affected the military version of the service, called Starshield, which drone operators rely on. title: Montenegro is ending visa-free travel for Russians. Moscow says Montenegrins will now need visas, too.
content_preview: Montenegrin citizens will need visas to travel to Russia, Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova told Izvestia. She confirmed that Montenegro’s Foreign Ministry had notified Russia that it was terminating the agreement governing travel between the two countries. Starting November 1, Russians will need visas to enter Montenegro. “As a result, Montenegrin citizens will also have to obtain visas to travel to Russia,” Zakharova said. On July 27, Montenegro officially announced it would introduce visa requirements for Russian citizens. The government said the changes were necessary to bring its visa policy into line with EU rules. Citizens of Belarus, China, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia will also need visas. On October 9, Montenegrin authorities detained Mikhail Zvinchuk, the creator of the Telegram channel “Rybar,” who had traveled there in part to film a report ahead of the new visa requirements for Russians. In 2024, the U.S. State Department announced a $10 million reward for information about Zvinchuk; he is also under EU sanctions. In the end, however, Montenegrin authorities simply expelled him and sent him back to Russia. cn_title: 据报道美国正考虑对伊朗使用“炸弹之母”，而伊朗誓言将继续抗争
cn_summary: 据报道，美军已制定针对伊朗的军事打击方案，其中包含在其军火库中使用威力巨大的非核炸弹的可能性。这一动向表明中东紧张局势进一步升级，引发国际社会对全面冲突爆发的严重关切。伊朗方面则表现出强硬姿态，誓言将继续进行抵抗。地缘政治的不稳定性正在对全球能源供应和供应链安全造成潜在威胁。国际社会呼吁有关各方保持克制，通过外交途径化解危机以避免地区局势失控。
impact: 中东紧张局势加剧可能导致全球能源价格波动，进而输入性推高中国国内生产成本。宏观经济层面，外部不确定性增加要求国内更加注重产业链安全与能源保供。对于就业市场而言，海外风险上升可能影响外贸企业的经营预期，间接对相关行业的青年就业和应届毕业生岗位供给产生一定压力。

cn_title: 受利率与人工智能担忧影响，日经225指数下跌5%
cn_summary: 受美国高于预期通胀数据的打击，科技股抛售潮率先在美国市场爆发，进而波及亚太资本市场。日本股市首当其冲，日经225指数单日大幅下跌5%。市场投资者对未来货币政策收紧的预期升温，同时对高估值的人工智能板块前景产生担忧。此次股市回调反映出全球金融市场对通胀走势与科技行业高增长可持续性的高度敏感。
impact: 海外资本市场的剧烈波动及科技股回调，可能通过全球金融市场风险偏好传导至中国A股和港股市场，对宏观经济的资本流动和投资者信心产生阶段性扰动。这要求国内金融机构和相关企业密切关注外部流动性收紧风险。对就业市场特别是金融行业和互联网高科技领域的青年毕业生而言，外部市场的波动可能导致部分企业放缓招聘节奏，促使求职者更加注重风险防范和向实体技术领域的扎实转型。

title: Yelena Morgunova, wife of Russian performance artist Pavel Krisevich, describes two arrests, threats against her family, and an ultimatum to leave Russia
content_preview: Yelena Morgunova On October 10, protest artist Pavel Krisevich said his wife, Yelena Morgunova, had managed to leave Russia after a series of “back-to-back” arrests. Police detained Morgunova in the Ryazan region on August 28 after she returned to Russia for a brief visit with relatives. Krisevich and Morgunova had been living in France since late 2025 — they left on a humanitarian visa after the artist served two jail terms for administrative offenses. In an interview with Meduza, Morgunova spoke about her detention, life in a Paris squat, and her relationship with former Pussy Riot member Rita Flores, who recently admitted to cooperating with Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB). Warning: This article contains profanity. ‘What if they gave you some assignment — to bring in explosives?’ — Where are you now? — I’m in Europe now, on my way to Paris to join Pasha. The problem is, I can’t fly because Céline [Morgunova and Krisevich’s dog] has a short, brachycephalic snout, and there’s a risk that the pressure inside her skull could rise on a plane. So I’m taking trains. It’s quite an experience. I used to think of France and Germany as some other planet. But when you travel like this, you see how close everything is. — How are you feeling? — I’m okay, in a sort of survival mode where you have to hold it together and can’t fall apart. I had to hold it together in the detention center. Then I got out, and right away I had to figure out where to stay, how to get [to France with the dog]. I still haven’t had a chance to settle anywhere. — What are your plans now? — We’ll apply for family reunification so I can get a [French] residence permit and permission to work [Morgunova previously had a French humanitarian visa, but it expired]. Then I’ll look for work so I have some money and can help my family. If I can’t see them, at least I can help them that way. Unlike Pasha, I didn’t apply for asylum at first. title: Six killed in Russian strike on warehouse in Ukraine’s Lutsk
content_preview: Russian drones struck a wholesale warehouse in Lutsk, killing six people, said regional Governor Roman Romaniuk. Five died at the scene, and a sixth died later in the hospital from their injuries. Romaniuk said 10 people were injured, while Ukraine’s State Emergency Service reported 12 injured. Romaniuk also said two people, including a child, were injured in a nine-story apartment building struck in the attack. cn_title: 俄外交部官员：拉夫罗夫将在亚信峰会期间举行系列会晤
cn_summary: 俄罗斯外交部发言人玛丽亚·扎哈罗娃表示，俄罗斯外长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫将在亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议（CICA，简称亚信峰会）期间开展一系列双边及多边会晤。此类高层会晤通常在多边国际活动的间隙举行，是外交沟通的重要平台。俄方将借此机会与相关国家代表就双边关系、地区热点问题及国际合作深入交换意见。这体现了俄罗斯在当前国际环境下持续深化与亚洲及全球南方国家外交关系的努力。
impact: 对中国宏观经济、就业市场和青年失业毕业生的影响分析：该外交动态有助于增进中国及周边地区的外交互信与经贸合作稳定性，对维持稳定的区域宏观经济环境具有积极意义。稳定的地缘政治环境有利于中外双边贸易和跨境投资的开展。对就业市场和青年毕业生而言，外贸、国际关系、跨境物流等相关涉外行业能够保持较为稳定的发展态势，为相关专业的毕业生提供持续的就业岗位。

title: 懂车帝回应：“245亿营收”“黑尊界”等均为谣言
content_preview: 汽车资讯平台懂车帝近日因尊界V800刹车踏板测试事件引发广泛关注。针对网络近日出现“懂车帝邀约博主黑尊界”“年营收超过245亿”等多个传言，懂车帝相关负责人回应上海证券报记者称，网传“黑尊界”相关言论不实，公司已溯源取证，将采取法律措施维护公司合法权益。上述人士表示，“245亿营收”来源于3月份的一篇网络AI生成文章。相关信息均为谣言，公司将追究造谣者的法律责任。（上证报）

title: 工信部：上半年储能电池产量超420GWh 坚决防范“内卷式”竞争
content_preview: 工业和信息化部副部长熊继军在致辞中表示，我国新型储能产业发展成效显著，下一步将统筹发展与安全，强化技术创新，坚持需求牵引，共建全球生态，坚决防范“内卷式”竞争，推动行业从规模扩张向创新引领转变。熊继军介绍，从产业规模看，2026年上半年储能电池产量超过420吉瓦时（GWh），同比增长110%；截至2026年6月底，新型储能累计装机超过1.53亿千瓦，较“十四五”初期增长50倍。（中证金牛座）

content: 来源：证券市场周刊杂志市场号 文 |水岸 牛市中，太多人相信“持有就会上涨”这一因果逻辑，下跌市，市场又在向所有人证明：明明什么也没做，却依然在失去。
cn_title: A股，还有机会！
cn_summary: 本文来源于《证券市场周刊》杂志市场号，由水岸撰文。文章指出，在牛市行情中，太多投资者坚信“只要持有就必然上涨”的因果逻辑；然而一旦进入下跌市，市场却在向所有人残酷地证明，明明自己什么也没有做，财富却依然在不断缩水。市场波动无常，投资者需要理性审视周期与人性。文章旨在探讨A股市场的内在逻辑与未来投资机遇。
impact: A股市场的走势与中国宏观经济基本面、企业盈利能力以及投资者预期紧密相连，直接影响广大居民的财产性收入和市场信心。资本市场的活跃度与实体经济融资、企业扩张步伐息息相关；市场向好有助于增强企业用工信心和扩招意愿，从而在一定程度上为高校毕业生等青年群体创造更多优质的就业岗位与职业发展空间。

title: ‘We aren’t selling our country. This isn’t about business for us.’ Zelensky says he feels betrayed, accuses Trump of siding with Moscow against Kyiv.
content_preview: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he regrets that Kyiv is losing a strong ally in Washington. Asked about his first reaction to the “diesel deal” between Russia and the United States, Zelensky told journalist Piers Morgan in an interview: “It’s a pity that we’re losing a strong partner.” Asked whether he felt betrayed by Trump, the Ukrainian president said, “Yes, but it’s a little bit more complicated than just my emotions or my feelings.” Zelensky said Ukraine is “losing” the United States through no fault of its own. Kyiv “can’t be weak,” he said, or it “will not survive.” “We are not selling our country. Look guys, it’s not about business for us. [It’s about] our lives — this is our country. It’s our home, our children,” he added. Zelensky said it was “painful” when U.S. President Donald Trump “took a side, and it’s not our side,” adding that he has no objection to Trump taking a neutral position. But if you’re in the middle, you have to stay in the middle, not on the wrong side. I think his advisers are wrong. I don’t know who is pushing him not to the right side. This is not the right side of history. Zelensky also said he considers businessman Elon Musk’s decision to restrict Starlink’s operation in Ukraine a mistake that will cost lives. Trump said on October 10 that he had reached an agreement with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Russian diesel supplies. The next day, he said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to a truce covering the energy sector. Zelensky said the announced truce “was news” to him. title: 韩日将100亿美元货币互换协议延长至2029年
content_preview: 韩国与日本同意将规模100亿美元的货币互换协议延期三年，原到期日为下月末，新协议有效期至2029年11月底。韩国企划财政部表示，副总理兼财政部长李炯日15日在曼谷与日本财务大臣片山皋月达成该协议。双方认为，目前两国外汇当局持有充足外币流动性，但考虑到该协议作为金融合作与政策协调标志所具备的象征意义，决定延续现有安排。（新浪财经）

cn_title: 印尼央行行长称油价波动是经济最大下行风险
cn_summary: 印度尼西亚央行行长指出，油价波动构成了当前经济面临的最大下行风险。此外，全球通货膨胀压力以及持续的高利率环境也对经济增长带来了显著风险。这些外部不确定性因素增加了新兴市场国家宏观经济调控的难度。印尼央行正密切关注全球能源市场的走势，以评估其对国内通胀和汇率的潜在冲击。政策制定者需要在稳定物价与支持经济增长之间寻找平衡。
impact: 国际油价波动和全球高利率环境直接影响中国输入性通胀压力及外部需求。对于中国宏观经济而言，输入性成本上升可能挤压中下游制造业利润，但同时也促使国内加速能源转型。在就业市场方面，外部经济的不确定性可能传导至出口相关行业，对青年毕业生的就业选择和岗位供给产生结构性影响，推动求职者向数字经济和绿色能源等内需驱动领域聚集。

content_preview: 【苹果智能接入阿里千问大模型，10月底在中国发布测试版本】据消息人士透露，阿里千问将作为AI能力集成至苹果智能，为iOS、iPadOS、macOS和visionOS的中国用户带来智能体验。用户无需在应用间切换，即可在苹果设备上直接体验千问的文本与图像理解、内容生成等能力。苹果董事会执行主席蒂姆·库克表示，苹果智能及相关阿里千问大模型确已获得批准，将在十月晚些时候发布测试版本，包含实时翻译、书写工具、照片清除工具等首批苹果智能功能，但Siri AI不包括在内。

content_preview: 【江波龙：预计2026年前三季度净利润同比增长1,864.55%至1,990.84%】金十数据10月15日讯，江波龙公告，预计2026年前三季度营业收入380亿元至400亿元；归母净利润140亿元至149亿元，2025年同期为7.13亿元，同比增长1,864.55%至1,990.84%；扣非净利润138亿元至148亿元，2025年同期为4.79亿元，同比增长2,782.36%至2,991.23%。业绩预告数据未经审计。公司以自研芯片、自研软件架构为技术引领，寻求差异化发展路径，大客户、高端客户及全球化客户占比持续提升，产品与客户结构进一步优化，驱动公司2026年第三季度盈利能力仍保持在历史较高水平。

title: IMF：韩元相对日元走强更多受益于AI热潮，而非两国利差变化
content_preview: IMF表示，韩元与日元走势出现分化，可能更多是受AI热潮的推动，而非两国利率差异所致。IMF指出，日本与韩国之间的债券收益率差距并未显著扩大，而且市场均已计入两国政策利率有所上升的预期。尽管如此，7月1日至9月3日期间，韩元兑日元仍升值了11%。IMF认为，这表明AI热潮对经常账户和资本账户的影响，更有可能是解释两种货币走势分化的原因。（新华财经）

cn_title: 中国暗示无论美欧贸易协议是否到期，稀土将继续向欧盟出口
cn_summary: 欧盟贸易委员马罗什·谢夫乔维奇于上周在北京会见了中国商务部长王文涛。中国在会谈中释放信号，表明无论美国与欧盟之间的贸易协议是否到期，中国稀土资源将继续保持对欧盟的稳定供应。这一表态突显了中欧在关键原材料供应链上的务实合作与沟通。这也展现了中国作为负责任大国在维护全球供应链稳定方面的态度。
impact: 对中国宏观经济而言，保持稀土等战略资源的稳定出口有利于巩固对外经贸关系和产业链外向型发展。对于高端制造、新能源及相关高技术产业链的发展具有积极支撑作用。在就业市场方面，相关外向型产业链的稳健运行有助于维持高新技术及贸易领域的就业岗位稳定，对青年毕业生专业对口就业形成利好。

title: Ukrainian drones strike Ryazan oil refinery, prompting school and kindergarten closures across the city
content_preview: Ryazan Governor Pavel Malkov said Ukrainian drones struck the region’s oil refinery, sparking a fire. A warehouse and vehicles were damaged at another facility in Ryazan, he added. Malkov did not report any casualties. The Ukrainian monitoring Telegram channel Exilenova+ published a photo early in the morning showing a flare over the Ryazan refinery, suggesting it was linked to the drone attack. The drone attack also forced authorities to cancel classes and kindergarten attendance on October 15 in Ryazan’s Oktyabrsky district and part of the Sovetsky district. Malkov’s post said 14 schools and 25 kindergartens were affected. The previous evening, Malkov said 23 drones had been shot down over the region in the past 24 hours. No casualties or damage were reported, he said. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced in an interview with the Financial Times that Ukraine’s military is resuming strikes on Russian oil refineries. He said Ukraine had not attacked Russian energy facilities for three days, in keeping with a request from the United States, but that Russia had continued striking Ukrainian energy infrastructure. cn_title: 乌克兰无人机袭击梁赞炼油厂，致使该市学校和幼儿园临时关闭
cn_summary: 据梁赞州州长帕维尔·马尔科夫透露，乌克兰无人机对该地区的炼油厂发动了袭击并引发火灾。此外，梁赞市的另一处设施也遭到波及，导致仓库和车辆受损。马尔科夫表示，目前尚无人员伤亡的报告。乌克兰监测电报频道“Exilenova+”在清晨发布了一张显示梁赞炼油厂上方有火光的照片，印证了此次无人机袭击事件。受袭击影响，当地政府被迫宣布取消10月15日的学校和幼儿园课程。
impact: 乌克兰无人机对俄罗斯炼油厂的持续袭击加剧了国际能源市场的地缘政治风险，可能引发原油及成品油价格的阶段性波动。这对中国保障能源进口安全、防范输入型通胀提出了更高要求。虽然事件不直接作用于中国国内就业，但能源价格的不确定性会影响中下游制造企业的成本控制。相关能源、化工及风险管理领域的青年毕业生在面对复杂多变的外部环境时，需具备更强的行业宏观研判能力。

title: Why are portions of prepared meals getting smaller in Russia? Rising costs may be only part of the answer.
content_preview: Portion sizes for prepared food in Russia fell by 10.3% over the past year to 266 grams (about 9.4 ounces), according to calculations by the analytics company Ntec, as cited by Kommersant. Prepared food remains the fastest-growing category in grocery retail. Retail stores account for about a quarter of the prepared food market, and that share could reach 40% by 2030, according to Stanislav Bogdanov, chairman of the Association of Retail Companies. Profit margins in the category are very low, however. Retailers have to invest in central kitchens, packaging, and logistics, while 14% of products are written off because of their short shelf life. Production costs are rising, but producers are finding it harder to pass them on to consumers. Intense competition and weakening demand are forcing them to hold down prices. As a result, producers are choosing to reduce portion sizes, experts said. Smaller portions may reflect both shrinkflation and changing demand, the experts said. Russians buying prepared food have increasingly been choosing small snacks such as onigiri, sandwiches, and hot dogs. In the first half of 2026, sales of these snacks rose by 48% in value, while sales of main dishes and salads grew more slowly — by 16% and 14%, respectively. title: Russian authorities move to evict war refugees from temporary shelters south of Moscow. Many have nowhere else to go.
content_preview: Marina, a refugee from the Donetsk region, at a temporary accommodation center in the Tula region The Tula regional government has decided to evict residents from local temporary accommodation centers. Since 2022, the centers have housed refugees from Ukraine and Russia’s border communities. Many are single mothers with children, older people, or people who only recently escaped the fighting and have yet to find work and settle in. They cannot return home: The war continues where they lived, and many homes and even entire communities have been destroyed. Journalists from the Bereg cooperative spoke with residents of one temporary accommodation center in the Tula region about how they became refugees and what they expect after eviction. Meduza is translating their report in full. ‘We’re all pleading with you not to throw us out on the street’ The parking lot outside a health resort in the Tula region is packed with cars bearing license plate codes rarely seen here. “180” and “181” designate the annexed Donetsk and Luhansk People’s Republics. The rarest code is “188.” Those plates were issued in the Kharkiv region during the six months in 2022 when Russia occupied part of the region. Schoolchildren play on swings outside two buildings that were temporarily converted into a refugee accommodation center just two years ago. Pine trees surround the courtyard. Adults sit on benches under plastic canopies, smoking and talking. These residents usually live in the neighboring complex, which has operated as a temporary accommodation center since 2022. In the summer, management moves them out and gives the better rooms to tourists and people attending forums held here. Those guests pay 8,000 rubles a night for the cheapest two-person cottage. The refugees praise the accommodations. Their only complaint is the food: Cooking in the rooms is prohibited, and the cafeteria food is sometimes undercooked or spoiled. Refugees waiting in line for food in the center’s cafeteria. The bags

cn_title: 乌克兰将恢复对俄炼油厂打击，打破“能源停火”希望
cn_summary: 由于莫斯科方面未能履行特朗普斡旋下拟议协议中的相关承诺，乌克兰宣布将恢复对俄罗斯能源目标的军事打击。这一决定彻底粉碎了此前市场对实现“能源停火”的乐观预期。分析人士担忧，新一轮针对炼油厂的袭击将再度加剧全球能源供应的脆弱性。地缘政治冲突的升级使国际原油和成品油市场重新面临严峻的供应扰动风险。
impact: 乌克兰恢复打击俄罗斯炼油厂可能导致国际油价再度剧烈震荡，对中国作为全球主要能源进口国的宏观经济成本构成潜在上涨压力。输入性通胀风险的上升会挤压中下游企业的利润空间，进而对企业用工规模和青年毕业生的求职招聘产生一定的不利收缩效应，加剧部分高耗能及相关服务行业的就业观望情绪。

title: 港媒：黄奇帆深圳机场被带走 传家人涉案
content_preview: 有中国政坛“不倒翁”之称的重庆原市长黄奇帆官宣被查，香港媒体报道，黄奇帆上星期六（10月10日）出席广东中山一场房地产活动后，在深圳机场被带走。他的儿子也涉案，被带走调查。 中央纪委国家监委网站星期二（10月13日）通报，重庆市委原副书记、市政府原市长黄奇帆涉嫌严重违纪违法被查。 中共重庆市委副书记、市长陈新武隔天（14日）主持召开市政府党组会议。《重庆日报》报道，与会者一致表示，坚决拥护党中央决定，坚决拥护中央纪委国家监委决定。 会议也提到，要始终保持清正廉洁的政治本色，坚持廉洁从政、廉洁修身、廉洁齐家，自觉净化社交圈、生活圈、朋友圈，从严管好身边人身边事。 香港《明报》星期四（15日）报道，据悉黄奇帆本月10日在中山市华邑酒店出席一个房地产开盘活动并发表演讲，相信是他被带走前的最后露面。消息人士称，黄奇帆当天在深圳机场被控制。 该报“中国透视”栏目也发表关于黄奇帆的文章，引述担任过长沙市人大党组副书记的刘耘微信公众号贴文称，“从已经公布情况看，绝大多数落马官员都有纵容家人以各种名目敛财，家风不正的问题，黄奇帆的具体问题有待官方权威公布，但大概率少不了家人经商敛财问题。” 文章也提到，社交媒体盛传黄奇帆的儿子黄然非也涉案，并引述知情人士的说法称，“从商的黄然非确实卷入其中，已被带走调查”。

cn_title: 海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会（GCC）宣布延期举行峰会
cn_summary: 海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会（GCC）正式宣布，由于胡塞武装发动的袭击活动，原定的海湾-欧盟峰会被迫延期。这一决定反映了红海及周边地区持续的安全威胁对高级别国际外交活动构成的直接影响。胡塞武装的军事行动不仅干扰了区域内的地缘政治对话，也对地区安全稳定构成了现实挑战。相关各方正在评估当前的安全局势，以确定峰会的重新举办日期。安全局势的恶化凸显了中东地缘政治的脆弱性。
impact: 中东地区安全局势的动荡对全球航运和国际贸易产生负面溢出效应，中国作为外贸依存度较高的经济体，需防范物流成本上升的风险。宏观上，区域不稳定可能扰乱全球经济复苏节奏。就业方面，受外贸航运和海外项目投资受阻影响，相关涉外企业可能调整招聘计划，对部分求职毕业生的海外就业及国际贸易岗位带来变数。

cn_title: 伊朗外交部称伊朗外长将于10月17日访问伊拉克并出席伊斯兰合作组织峰会
cn_summary: 伊朗外交部宣布，伊朗外长将于10月17日对伊拉克进行正式访问，期间将出席在当地举行的伊斯兰合作组织峰会。此次访问正值中东地区局势高度紧张之际，外交接触备受国际社会关注。预计双方将在会晤中就地区安全、双边合作以及共同关心的热点问题交换意见。此举体现了伊朗通过区域外交缓解地缘政治压力的意图。峰会的召开也将为中东国家协调立场提供重要平台。
impact: 中东地缘政治局势的演变直接影响中国宏观经济中的能源安全与海外贸易通道稳定。对于中国宏观经济而言，中东局势动荡可能带来国际油价震荡，进而影响国内工业品价格与通胀预期。在就业市场方面，中东地区的政治波动可能对中国企业在当地的基建投资和外派劳务人员的安全及就业产生阶段性扰动，但同时也对外语、国际法、跨国风险管理等专业的青年人才提出了持续的需求。

cn_title: 巴西大选为何关乎整个地球？原因在此
cn_summary: 巴西即将迎来新一轮大选，这场选举的影响力远远超出了其国界，将波及全球。作为地球生态系统健康的关键支撑，亚马逊雨林在应对全球气候变化中扮演着至关重要的角色。因此，本次大选的结果将直接塑造亚马逊未来的命运，进而影响全球的环境走向。国际社会对巴西新政府在环保政策和可持续发展上的立场给予了高度关注。大选不仅是国内政治的抉择，更是全球生态治理的重要转折点。
impact: 巴西大选及其生态政策的走向，将直接影响全球碳交易市场、大宗商品供应链以及国际气候多边合作，从而对中国推进“双碳”目标和绿色宏观经济转型产生外部参考。在就业市场中，绿色金融、碳核算、生态农业以及国际环境法律等领域的专业人才需求将持续增长。这为相关专业的青年毕业生提供了广阔的就业蓝海，鼓励青年投身全球可持续发展和绿色经济建设中。

title: 中国官方调查组：被抽检纸尿裤样品未检出甲酰胺
content_preview: 中国官方调查组针对婴幼儿纸尿裤甲酰胺问题展开调查后公布，被抽检的纸尿裤成品样品未检出甲酰胺。调查组也称，宣称在婴幼儿纸尿裤中检出甲酰胺的多家检测主体，存在检测过程及判定依据不严谨、删除原始数据等问题。 多款在中国市场销售的知名婴幼儿纸尿裤，6月被曝检出有害物质甲酰胺，中国多个政府部门成立联合调查组展开核查。 据新华社报道，中国国家市场监督管理总局星期四（10月15日）通报，市场监管总局、工业和信息化部、国家卫生健康委、国家疾控局成立联合调查组，全面深入开展调查工作。 报道称，联合调查组对中国国内168家婴幼儿纸尿裤生产企业（含代工企业）进行全面抽检，包含180个品牌368批次纸尿裤成品样品，委托中国疾病预防控制中心、中国质量检验检测科学研究院等权威机构进行检测，未检出甲酰胺。 此外，受检企业均符合消毒产品生产卫生规范要求，未发现生产工艺及原材料中存在添加或含有甲酰胺的情况。 报道也说，舆情涉及的宣称在婴幼儿纸尿裤中检出甲酰胺的多家检测主体，存在定性原则不明确、未开展空白样和平行样检测、检测过程及判定依据不严谨、删除原始数据等问题，无法得出检出甲酰胺的结论。 联合调查组也委托国家卫生健康委临床检验中心、中国疾病预防控制中心、中国医科大学附属第一医院、北京协和医院等单位院士、专家多次论证和验证形成血液样本甲酰胺检测方法，并用该方法对舆情关注的某机构检测的血液样本进行复检，未检出甲酰胺。 报道称，根据目前调查和检测结果，未发现婴幼儿纸尿裤带来的甲酰胺相关健康危害。

cn_title: 法国央行行长告诉CNBC：法国正“整顿内务”，可在三年内将赤字削减至3%
cn_summary: 法国央行行长表示，法国完全有能力削减令全球投资者深感担忧的巨额预算赤字。他强调法国目前正在积极“整顿内务”，并有信心在未来三年内将财政赤字率降至欧盟规定的3%的目标水平。此番言论旨在向国际金融市场重建信心，缓解外界对法国财政健康状况的忧虑。欧洲央行及主要经济体官员正密切评估该国财政整顿计划的可行性。
impact: 法国财政状况的改善有助于维护欧元区宏观经济的稳定性，对中欧双边贸易及外部宏观经济环境产生稳定的外溢效应。对于中国的外贸出口企业而言，欧洲市场的财政和经济趋稳有利于维持订单需求，从而间接稳固国内涉外经济产业链的就业岗位，为青年毕业生提供相对稳定的外贸及相关服务业就业机会。

cn_summary: 俄罗斯驻日本大使尼古拉·诺兹德雷夫对日本政府就中国代表团访问择捉岛（日称北方四岛之一）所提出的抗议予以严词拒绝。诺兹德雷夫指出，莫斯科与北京在全面伙伴关系和战略协作框架下的务实合作与跨区域交流将继续稳步增长。这一表态表明了俄方在领土问题上的坚定立场，以及深化对华全方位合作的意愿。中俄之间的正常交往不容第三方干涉，展现了两国关系的紧密程度。此举也再次引发了国际社会对日俄领土争议及地缘政治格局的关注。
impact: 该事件体现了中俄战略协作的不断深化以及在国际事务中的相互支持，有利于维护中国在相关地区的多边合作空间。对中国宏观经济、国内就业市场和青年毕业生就业无直接实质性影响。

cn_title: 国际货币基金组织警告：沙特袭击升级或引发全球经济波及效应
cn_summary: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃警告称，也门胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯基础设施的打击可能会对全球经济产生负面影响。她在泰国与世界银行举办的联合活动上表示了这一担忧。尽管存在地缘政治风险，但由于近年来致力于经济多元化以减少对石油收入的依赖，沙特经济表现出较强韧性，其经济前景优于大多数邻国。不过，整体局势依然存在不确定性。能源供应链的安全仍是国际社会关注的焦点。
impact: 中东地缘冲突与沙特基础设施受袭将直接推高全球原油价格，增加中国作为全球最大原油进口国的输入性通胀压力，进而对宏观经济运行成本产生影响。这可能导致部分制造业和交通运输业成本上升，对企业利润空间造成挤压，并间接影响就业市场的岗位扩张速度。对于应届毕业生而言，宏观成本上升可能使部分行业招聘趋于谨慎，特别是在外贸、物流及能源相关领域。

title: 中国大使批菲反华势力将黑手伸向华文教育
content_preview: 菲律宾华文教育近期遭质疑后，全菲超180名中国华文教师出于安全考虑回国。中国驻菲律宾大使井泉批菲反华势力将黑手伸向华文教育，其图谋绝不会得逞。 中国驻菲大使馆微信公众号消息，井泉星期二（10月13日）出席菲律宾亚典耀大学孔子学院建院20周年庆典并发表讲话时作出上述表态。 他称，人文交流是中菲关系根基所在。一段时间以来，菲反华势力掀起一股股反华声浪，却占不到任何便宜，近来竟然将黑手伸向华文教育，污蔑这是中国的“统战工作”和“政治渗透”。井泉批评，这完全是“无稽之谈、胡说八道”。 他表示，有180多名中国华文教师出于自身安全考虑不得不离开菲律宾，令人遗憾，也反映出反华势力是何其卑劣，是多么让人鄙视。 井泉说，这些人的所作所为逆历史潮流而行，其图谋绝不会得逞。他呼吁相关大学、孔院、华校、华社一定要坚定信心，不要被恐吓威胁吓倒，坚定不移去做正确的事情，大力促进中菲在文化、教育、人文领域的交流。 “让两国关系稳下来，让两国人民更加走近，这符合两国人民的共同愿望。”井泉承诺，中国使馆会一如既往提供力所能及的支持与帮助。 据此前报道，美国“海光倡议”（SeaLight Initiative）负责人鲍威尔（Ray Powell）及菲国防部长特奥多罗此前接连批评当地华文教育，引发中国教师家属对安全的担忧，要求安排他们回国。 《菲律宾商报》引述消息称，菲华商联总会基于安全考量，已安排教师撤离。 据香港《明报》报道，菲律宾现有约130至150所华文学校，外派教师是当地华文师资的重要补充。

cn_title: IMF总裁：斯科特·贝森特的增长计划不足以遏制飙升的赤字和债务堆积
cn_summary: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃表示，美国财政部官员斯科特·贝森特单纯依赖经济增长来削减赤字的方案并不可行，无法以足够快的速度消化高达40万亿美元的巨额美债。她公开呼吁美国必须采取切实的财政整顿措施，以恢复财政可持续性。IMF认为，单纯寄希望于通过增长摆脱债务泥潭面临巨大风险，结构性财政改革刻不容缓。这一表态凸显了国际组织对美国中长期财政健康的深度担忧。
impact: 美国债务危机隐患和IMF的警告增加了全球经济复苏的不确定性，对中国宏观经济的外部环境带来一定扰动。全球金融市场的潜在风险可能波及资本市场，间接影响国内金融行业的景气度。在就业市场方面，跨国金融机构和外贸企业可能会因外部经济环境承压而优化招聘计划，对相关专业的应届生就业带来一定压力。不过，这也促使国内进一步深化金融供给侧结构性改革，提升国内经济内生增长动力，为青年提供更多扎根本土的高质量就业机会。

title: Russian rapper Navai detained at Kazakhstan’s border with Kyrgyzstan on suspicion of drug smuggling
content_preview: Russian rapper Navai Bakirov, known as Navai, has been detained in Kazakhstan on suspicion of drug smuggling. He was taken to a temporary detention facility. Navai was scheduled to perform in Astana on October 14. Organizers said the concert had been postponed indefinitely “for technical reasons.” Baza, citing checkpoint staff, reported that 10 grams (about 0.35 ounces) of marijuana was found in Navai’s car. title: 山东卫健委通报：多人因纸尿裤甲酰胺问题被处理
content_preview: 据央视，根据国家联合调查组调查情况，山东省卫生健康委员会会同有关方面，依据《中华人民共和国医师法》《中国共产党问责条例》《中国共产党纪律处分条例》《关于实行党政领导干部问责的暂行规定》《事业单位工作人员处分规定》等有关规定，按照干部管理权限和处分批准权限，对相关医疗机构和责任人员违规违纪违法等问题进行调查核实并严肃追责问责。现将有关情况通报如下。 一、于某衍违规违纪违法主要问题 于某衍在未经伦理审查和未取得患者知情同意的情况下，擅自开展样本检测和医学研究活动，并在未确认检测数据真实性和准确性情况下，向媒体披露不实信息，其行为严重违反医师职业道德、医学伦理规范，造成恶劣社会影响。 经研究，给予于某衍吊销医师执业证书，五年禁止从事医学临床研究的行政处罚；降低岗位等级处分，由副主任医师（7级）降为主治医师（9级）；给予留党察看一年处分；撤销山东省公共卫生临床中心整合与转化医学中心特聘主任职务。 二、山东省公共卫生临床中心违规违纪主要问题 于某衍违规违纪违法问题暴露出山东省公共卫生临床中心临床检验实验室样本管理存在疏漏、发布信息不规范等问题。山东省公共卫生临床中心党委书记张某法，党委副书记、主任刘某明，党委委员、副主任苏某，科教部副主任王某，科研科科长朱某华履职不力。 经研究，给予山东省公共卫生临床中心党委书记张某法诫勉；给予山东省公共卫生临床中心党委副书记、主任刘某明批评教育；给予山东省公共卫生临床中心党委委员、副主任苏某党内警告处分；给予山东省公共卫生临床中心科教部副主任王某警告处分；给予山东省公共卫生临床中心科研科科长朱某华党内严重警告处分，免职处理。

title: 蒋万安沈伯洋10月31日举行电视辩论
content_preview: 台湾“九合一”地方选举进入倒数阶段，寻求连任的国民党籍台北市长蒋万安与民进党籍对手沈伯洋，确定将在10月31日举行首场电视辩论。 综合中时新闻网和《联合报》报道，双方竞选团队星期四（10月15日）下午展开第二轮协商，经过约两小时讨论，敲定首场辩论于10月31日中午12时至下午2时举行，由政治立场亲绿的三立电视与亲蓝的TVBS联合主办，辩论将包括交叉诘问和媒体提问环节。 台湾将在11月28日举行“九合一”地方选举。随着选举临近，台北市长选情也出现变化。 TVBS在5月下旬公布蒋万安以58%支持度碾压沈伯洋的30%。五个月后，TVBS上星期四（10月8日）最新民调显示，蒋万安和沈伯洋的支持度分别为49%、41%，差距已大幅拉近到8个百分点。

cn_title: 随着AI股票抛售潮加剧，英伟达、AMD、美光股价下跌
cn_summary: 周四，全球科技硬件股票的抛售潮进一步加深。作为人工智能芯片和存储芯片领域的龙头企业，英伟达、AMD和美光等公司的股价均出现显著下跌。此次市场回调反映了投资者对前期人工智能板块估值过高以及未来需求增速的担忧。科技股的集体走弱拖累了全球主要资本市场的表现。分析人士认为，这标志着市场对高热度AI概念股正进行理性的风险评估与挤泡沫过程。
impact: 全球AI板块股票遭抛售将对中国资本市场的半导体、人工智能及科技板块产生情绪面和资金面的传染效应，加剧A股相关科技股的波动。宏观经济层面，全球科技投资热度降温可能放缓相关产业链的资本开支。对于中国高校毕业生和就业市场而言，半导体与AI领域的快速扩张势头若受资本市场回调影响，相关高科技企业的校园招聘和岗位扩张速度可能会趋于保守，求职竞争将更加激烈。

title: ‘Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the U.S. government.’ Musk responds to Ukraine’s complaints about restrictions on the military version of Starlink.
content_preview: SpaceX has restored service in Ukraine for Starlink satellite terminals moving at high speeds, former Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov said on the evening of October 14. “Starlink connectivity at speeds of up to 160 km/h [about 100 mph] is being restored. Removing Starshield ’s speed limit entirely is now critical for Ukraine’s defense. Thank you, Elon Musk. We hope for your continued support,” Fedorov said on social media. In response , Musk said Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the U.S. government. “Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS,” Musk said. He said Starlink is a commercial service whose use is “limited to civilian or defensive activities.” Ukraine’s Defense Ministry told journalists that SpaceX still imposes a speed limit of 161 kilometers per hour (about 100 mph) on the terminals. “However, we’re currently seeing improved connection quality at speeds of up to 160 [km],” officials said. Ukrainian military personnel and officials said on the morning of October 14 that SpaceX had restricted service without warning for Starlink terminals used by Ukraine’s armed forces on the front lines. The restrictions affected Starshield, the military version of Starlink needed to launch drones. Some even compared the damage the Starlink slowdown caused Ukraine’s armed forces to a nuclear strike on Ukraine. title: FEDS Paper: Inattentive Price Setting and Inflation Under Fiscal Policy Uncertainty
content_preview: Oliver Pfäuti and Edson Wu How do high public debt and fiscal uncertainty interact to shape inflation? We develop a model in which firms face uncertainty about both marginal costs and fiscal policy and choose how much information to acquire before setting prices. Higher debt raises steady-state taxes, affecting attention through two opposing forces. While these taxes reduce the profit stakes of mispricing, they make desired prices more sensitive to tax fluctuations, increasing the value of information. The interaction generates a U-shaped relationship between public debt and attention, and therefore between debt and inflation volatility. Using euro-area firm-level expectations data, we document that the passthrough of expected input-cost growth into expected selling-price growth rises systematically with a country's debt-to-GDP ratio, consistent with the model. In the calibrated general-equilibrium model, an increase in debt from 100% to 175% of GDP raises inflation volatility by about 20%, mainly because firms reallocate attention toward fiscal shocks.

We develop a model in which firms face uncertainty about both marginal costs and fiscal policy and choose how much information to acquire before setting prices. Higher debt raises steady-state taxes, affecting attention through two opposing forces. While these taxes reduce the profit stakes of mispricing, they make desired prices more sensitive to tax fluctuations, increasing the value of information. The interaction generates a U-shaped relationship between public debt and attention, and therefore between debt and inflation volatility. Using euro-area firm-level expectations data, we document that the passthrough of expected input-cost growth into expected selling-price growth rises systematically with a country's debt-to-GDP ratio, consistent with the model. In the calibrated general-equilibrium model, an increase in debt from 100% to 175% of GDP raises inflation volatility by about 20%, mainly because firms reallocate attention toward fiscal shocks.

title: 法新社调查：中国经济三季料同比增长4.4%
content_preview: 法新社对分析师展开调查后公布结果，预测中国经济在第三季同比增长4.4%。 中国将在星期一（10月19日）公布第三季经济增长数据，中国经济在第一和第二季度分别增长5%和4.3%。 官方将今年全年增长目标设定在4.5%至5%。这是中国数十年来，首次将GDP增速目标定在5%以下。 牛津经济研究院高级经济学家谢娜·岳（Sheana Yue，音译）告诉法新社：“现有数据表明，中国经济失去冲力。” 谢娜·岳认为，主要挑战在于持续疲软的内需，尤其是消费和房地产投资，而且靠额外基础设施支出，恐怕难以迅速扭转这一局面。 国际货币基金组织本周也将中国今年经济增长预测，从4.6%略微下调至4.5%。

title: Ukraine charges five Russian scientists with war crimes over excavations in annexed Crimea
content_preview: Ukraine is investigating criminal cases against five Russian archaeologists over excavations in occupied Crimea, BBC Russia reported , citing prosecutorial and court documents obtained by the outlet. The archaeologists have been designated as suspects in absentia in war crimes investigations. BBC names two of the suspects: the leaders of an excavation at the medieval site of Solkhat : Mark Kramarovsky, an 86-year-old Soviet and Russian scientist who founded the excavation in 1978 and has led it ever since, and Emil Seydaliev, a senior researcher at the Institute of Archaeology of Crimea. The Ukrainian outlet Graty reported in August that Ukraine had formally designated Kramarovsky and Seydaliev as suspects. Ukrainian investigators said the scientists carried out illegal excavations at Solkhat, helped Russia appropriate the valuables found there in violation of international humanitarian law, and damaged the cultural layer beyond repair. BBC does not name the other three scientists. Since 2014, the excavation has received permits from Moscow, BBC said, and its finds have been handed over to the Crimean Tatar Museum of Cultural and Historical Heritage, established by Russian authorities. All the objects have been entered into Russia’s museum fund. Ukrainian prosecutors believe this has led to the “illegal appropriation of Ukrainian cultural heritage.” Emil Seydaliev was born in Crimea, held Ukrainian citizenship and later obtained a Russian passport. He has worked in Crimea his entire life and called the criminal case against him and his colleagues a farce. In December 2025, Polish security services detained Russian archaeologist Alexander Butyagin, who had conducted excavations in Crimea for many years. Since 1999, Butyagin had led the Myrmekion archaeological expedition, which studies the ancient site of Myrmekion in present-day Kerch. cn_title: 俄原子能公司CEO：扎波罗热热电厂宣布停火以进行设备维修
cn_summary: 俄罗斯国家原子能公司（Rosatom）首席执行官阿列克谢·利哈切夫宣布，扎波罗热热电厂已实施停火，以便开展关键设备的抢修工作。他强调，此举将有助于进一步巩固扎波罗热核电站的电力供应安全，显著降低该核电站再次面临稳定电力供应中断的潜在风险。核安全历来是国际社会关注的焦点，电网稳定性对于防止核事故至关重要。此次局部停火为设施维护创造了必要的安全窗口期。
impact: 该事件对中国宏观经济的直接影响较小，但全球能源安全和核安全局势的平稳有利于国际大宗商品价格的稳定。中国作为核能和平利用的大国，高度重视核安全及相关产业链的稳健发展。相关核电技术、电力设备维护等领域的国际经验交流对我国相关行业有一定参考价值。对国内能源及工程类专业的青年毕业生而言，国家对核能安全与新型电力系统建设的持续投入创造了稳定的就业岗位。

title: Russia plans a new pretrial detention center outside Moscow. With room for 4,000 detainees, it would be the largest in the country.
content_preview: Russia’s largest pretrial detention center will be built in the Solnechnogorsk district of the Moscow region. The regional office of the Federal Penitentiary Service has put the construction contract out to bid. The center will hold up to 4,000 detainees. The complex will cover more than 42 hectares (about 104 acres). It will include multistory buildings for men and women, as well as separate buildings for people with tuberculosis and criminal gang leaders deemed a harmful influence on other detainees. The complex will also include three buildings with apartment-style accommodations for Federal Penitentiary Service employees. The complex will be built near the 71-kilometer (44-mile) marker on the M-11 highway, between the villages of Shapkino and Ozhogino. The starting price for the construction contract is 37.8 billion rubles. Construction is scheduled to be completed in October 2031. Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin signed an order in 2022 to build a pretrial detention center for 4,000 people in the Moscow region. The project received final approval from state expert reviewers this past winter. “Kolpino,” known as “Kresty-2,” is currently considered Russia’s largest pretrial detention center. It was built in a suburb of St. Petersburg in 2017. Construction took 10 years. title: 加美贸易谈判前 加叫停购美“黑鹰”直升机
content_preview: 【加美贸易谈判前 加叫停购美“黑鹰”直升机】财联社10月15日电，据加拿大方面14日消息，加拿大政府此前在与美国开始新一轮贸易谈判前，曾悄悄下令暂停采购16架美国制造的UH-60M“黑鹰”直升机。消息称，多位消息人士透露，暂停采购的决定与加美之间的贸易和外交紧张局势有关。由于加拿大寻求减少对美国的军事依赖，加政府认为在没有竞标程序的情况下购买美国直升机，时机并不合适。除暂停购买“黑鹰”直升机外，加政府还在继续审查是否会购买一批由美国公司生产的F-35隐形战斗机。

title: Ukrainian drones are hitting Russia’s biggest data centers. Why are they so vulnerable — and can anything protect them?
content_preview: A Yandex data center in Vladimir. 2019. After strikes on Yandex’s data centers, pro-war channels accused the company of inaction and even sabotage. Elements of critical infrastructure turned out to be completely unprotected against drone attacks. Now similar accusations will likely be directed at Sberbank: the bank’s largest data center in the Saratov region was attacked overnight on October 14. All these facilities were an obvious target for Ukraine’s military, if only because Russian forces are actively striking similar targets in Ukraine. Of course, the inadequate protection of the data centers has nothing to do with malicious intent or negligence on the part of Yandex and Sberbank’s management. It is known that, even before the strikes, authorities and the military discussed measures to defend such facilities with businesses. And judging by video of the attacks , at least in Yandex’s case some defense — probably in the form of mobile fire teams or automatic turrets — did exist: drones were fired at with small arms. This shows that Russia still lacks the resources to build a multilayered anti-drone air defense system anywhere except Moscow. And site-level defenses at individual factories, warehouses, and data centers cannot repel massed strikes. First, a reminder of which facilities Ukraine’s military struck Ukrainian strikes hit three of Yandex’s six largest data centers, also known as data processing centers, between October 7 and 11. None were located in the Moscow region, the area most heavily protected by Russian air defenses. The data center in Sasovo, in the Ryazan region, which also housed two of Yandex’s three supercomputers, stopped operating entirely. Judging by satellite images from the Planet Labs, the wing of the building housing the data center had burned down completely. The data center in Vladimir (one of two in the city) also shut down completely, while the one in Kaluga sustained significant damage. A Ukrainian strike hit Sberbank’s Mega Data C

title: 【阿斯利康加码AI药物研发 向Insitro支付4000万美元预付款】金十数据10月15日讯，阿斯利康与机器学习生物技术
content_preview: 【阿斯利康加码AI药物研发 向Insitro支付4000万美元预付款】金十数据10月15日讯，阿斯利康与机器学习生物技术公司Insitro达成一项价值最高18.6亿美元的合作协议，旨在利用人工智能帮助这家英国制药商发现治疗肝脏和心脏疾病的新药。阿斯利康周四表示，将向Insitro支付4000万美元预付款。Insitro将结合自身及阿斯利康的数据，深入研究一种脂肪肝疾病和心肌疾病的发病机制。如果研究取得成功，Insitro有望获得最高14.6亿美元的额外付款，以及潜在的药品销售特许权使用费。这笔交易是制药行业押注人工智能能够加快发现新药靶点的最新案例。Insitro此前已与礼来和百时美施贵宝达成药物研发合作协议。这家总部位于加州的生物技术公司获得了Andreessen Horowitz、贝莱德和淡马锡等机构的投资。

cn_summary: 在该项目框架下，计划在美国纽约州新建两座工厂，项目资金高达210亿美元。这一合作凸显了日美两国在半导体和人工智能关键技术领域的深度绑定。随着全球AI产业链加速重构，跨国技术联盟正在成为大国竞争的重要形态。日本官员对此类项目的重视，反映出其试图通过加强与美国的同盟关系来确保自身在尖端科技领域的地位。此类双边半导体合作也将对全球供应链格局产生深远影响。
impact: 对中国宏观经济而言，日美在半导体和AI领域的深度合作增加了中国外部科技封锁的压力，倒逼国内加速推进核心技术自主可控。在就业市场方面，半导体与AI高端制造的国际竞争促使国内相关高新技术企业加大研发投入，对复合型工程技术人才的需求持续旺盛。对于青年毕业生而言，这既意味着芯片、人工智能及高端装备制造领域的就业机遇增多，也对毕业生的跨学科创新能力和技术硬实力提出了更高要求。

cn_summary: 本文梳理了10月15日星期四俄罗斯主流媒体的头条新闻。核心报道聚焦于地缘政治的最新紧张局势，特别是俄方对西方国家在乌克兰冲突中角色的评估。报道指出乌克兰与欧盟的政策正在将和平推得更远。同时，美国被指切断了基辅方面的导弹瞄准系统支持。这些动态反映了当前国际外交和军事博弈的复杂性与危险性。俄罗斯媒体持续密集报道冲突的幕后动向与战略调整。
impact: 该地缘政治事件加剧了全球能源和供应链的不确定性，间接对中国宏观经济的输入型通胀和外贸环境产生扰动。在就业市场方面，全球经济复苏放缓可能对部分涉外企业的岗位增长带来短期压力。对于中国广大应届毕业生而言，特别是国际政治、贸易和语言类专业的青年，海外风险的增加要求其更加关注全球宏观形势变化，调整职业预期并提升综合应对能力。

title: 库克：苹果智能接入阿里千问大模型，10月底在中国发布测试版本
content_preview: 10月15日，苹果董事会执行主席蒂姆·库克在上海走访，接受媒体采访。在谈及Apple Intelligence（苹果智能）相关问题时，库克表示苹果智能及相关阿里千问大模型确已获得批准，将在十月晚些时候发布测试版本，其中包含实时翻译、书写工具、照片清除工具等首批苹果智能功能，但是Siri AI这次不包括在内。“但是我们很高兴，首批核心的苹果智能功能是可以慢慢上线了。”库克说道。 据消息人士透露，阿里千问将作为AI能力集成至Apple智能，为 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS 的中国用户带来智能体验。用户无需在应用间切换，即可在 Apple 设备上直接体验千问的文本与图像理解、内容生成等能力。（硬AI）

title: Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to stop attacking oil refineries. Three days later, Moscow alleges two Ukrainian strikes — neither reported by regional authorities.
content_preview: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said Ukraine attacked two Russian oil refineries on October 14. “According to the Energy Ministry and the companies, the Kyiv regime attacked two oil refineries today — in the Saratov and Ryazan regions. We see no sign that the Ukrainian side is moving toward an energy ceasefire,” he said. Novak did not specify which refineries had been attacked. Authorities in the two regions had not said that any refineries had been attacked that day. Rostov Governor Yury Slyusar said on Telegram that morning that more than 160 drones had been destroyed or disabled over the region, but stressed that “no reports of casualties or any impact on the ground had come in.” Saratov Governor Roman Busargin said a civilian had been killed and residential buildings damaged in Balakovo, which is home to a Sber data center (the governor did not mention it). Busargin did not say that an attack had been repelled in Saratov, where the region’s only oil refinery is located. Meduza could find no reports of explosions or fires at Russian oil refineries on Russian or Ukrainian monitoring channels. U.S. President Donald Trump said on October 11 that Russia and Ukraine had agreed not to strike each other’s oil refineries. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the announcement “was news” to him, but later said the Ukrainian armed forces had “received all the relevant orders.” Zelensky did not explicitly confirm that he had agreed to stop attacks on oil refineries. title: Ukraine strikes a Sberbank data center in Russia. Meanwhile, Kyiv isn’t getting crucial missile warnings from the U.S., and SpaceX is restricting Starlink.
content_preview: A fire in a residential building in Kyiv after a Russian attack on October 13 Russia Ukrainian drones struck a data center operated by Sberbank in the city of Balakovo in the Saratov region overnight on October 14. Ukrainian monitoring channels were the first to report the attack. Saratov Governor Roman Busargin said the strike damaged residential buildings in Balakovo and killed one person. He said all infrastructure facilities in the city are “operating normally.” A few hours later, Sberbank First Deputy Chairman Alexander Vedyakhin confirmed the attack on the data center, saying all the bank’s systems and services are “operating normally.” The bank’s press service said no employees were injured. This is the first Ukrainian attack on Sberbank data centers. Last week, Ukrainian drones struck data centers belonging to Yandex in the Ryazan and Vladimir regions, as well as in Kaluga. Sberbank announced plans to build a data center in the Saratov region in 2020 and began construction the following year. The facility is expected to cover almost 60,000 square meters (about 646,000 square feet). Authorities said it would be the largest data center in Europe, and one of Sberbank’s supercomputers is being built at the Balakovo site. Ukraine Ukraine’s Western partners once again failed to warn Kyiv that Russia was preparing a ballistic missile strike on the capital, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on the evening of October 13. He said the missiles were detected only as they approached Kyiv. The main target was the CHP-4 power plant, one of Kyiv’s major energy facilities. Ukrainian Air Force spokesperson Yurii Ihnat said partners did not warn Ukraine ahead of the first ballistic missile strike during the overnight attack on October 14, but did send notifications ahead of the three subsequent waves of strikes. title: 一单VIP服务价格能超50万美元 婚恋中介也受益于AI热潮的造富效应
content_preview: 在硅谷从事婚恋介绍行业23年后，Amy Andersen已习惯于服务那些财力雄厚、时间紧张的客户。但最近，这位加州门洛帕克Linx Dating的创始人发现，一个新客群开始找上门来：Perplexity、Anthropic和英伟达等公司的员工。Andersen说，过去几年她的生意大火，需求主要来自AI热潮催生的富人 —— 这股热潮不仅仅惠及科技工作者，还连带造福了法律、房地产等行业的人员。 Andersen的工作就像猎头兼约会教练。她会在各类活动、网络平台和社交媒体上，以及从自己那个约2.5万名合格单身人士数据库中挖掘配对目标。客户可以获得形象咨询、专业摄影，以及约会前后辅导等各种服务。她目前的客户年龄介于20岁至75岁，有男有女，并愿意花费重金解决约会应用程序未能解决的问题。 Andersen的收费是7.5万美元起，VIP服务甚至能超过50万美元，具体价格主要取决于会员期限、寻访难度和介绍对象的数量。Andersen说，大多数VIP客户在确定排他性恋爱关系、订婚或结婚时，还会支付“里程碑奖金”，金额往往高达数十万美元。（彭博）

cn_title: 乌克兰无人机引发梁赞炼油厂火灾，泽连斯基誓言恢复袭击
cn_summary: 乌克兰无人机袭击导致俄罗斯梁赞炼油厂发生火灾。乌克兰总统泽连斯基在接受英国《金融时报》采访时表示，此前关于停止袭击炼油厂的限制已经解除，并指责俄罗斯拒绝遵守特朗普宣布的相关协议。这一表态意味着乌克兰将恢复对俄罗斯本土核心能源基础设施的大规模打击。地缘冲突在能源领域的再度升级，引发了国际社会对全球能源供应安全的新一轮担忧。
impact: 乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击升级，直接推高了国际原油市场的供应风险和价格波动性，从而对中国输入性通胀和宏观经济成本构成潜在压力。石油化工等相关产业链的企业成本可能面临上升。对于青年毕业生和就业市场而言，国际能源价格波动将利好新能源转型、能源安全研究及相关工程技术领域的长期人才需求，但也对传统外贸和海外资源开发类企业的海外稳健经营提出了更高要求。

cn_summary: 俄罗斯防空系统在夜间遭受了大规模袭击，成功拦截并击落了总计166架乌克兰无人机。与此同时，位于俄罗斯梁赞州的一家炼油厂在袭击中不幸起火，能源基础设施再次遭到战火波及。罗斯托夫州州长尤里·斯图萨尔表示，仅在南部罗斯托夫州的四个市镇上空就有20多架无人机被摧毁。这表明俄乌冲突的无人机空袭战仍在持续升级，双方在能源和战略设施上的攻防日趋激烈。
impact: 俄乌冲突持续升级及其对能源设施的打击，进一步加剧了全球地缘政治紧张局势和国际能源市场的动荡。对于中国宏观经济而言，国际油价和天然气价格的潜在波动可能输入性地影响国内大宗商品价格和通胀预期。在就业和外部环境方面，地缘冲突对全球供应链的扰动增加了外贸企业的运营成本，相关涉外行业和海外项目的青年就业可能面临更多外部风险。

title: 库克：苹果智能已在中国获批
content_preview: 苹果执行董事长库克说，苹果智能在中国已经获得批准。 库克星期四（10月15日）接受澎湃新闻采访时说，苹果智能在中国已经获得批准。10月晚些时候有个测试版本，首批功能有实时翻译、写作工具、图像消除，Siri AI不包括在里面。 彭博社星期三（14日）引述知情者透露，苹果公司计划于12月在中国大陆地区推出苹果智能，作为即将发布的iOS 27.3更新的一部分。此次发布将包含两年前率先在美国面向iPhone、iPad和Mac推出的人工智能（AI）功能。 苹果为在中国推出苹果智能已筹备多年。公司一度认为可以在2025年5月发布，但随后推迟至2025年底，跟着再次推迟至今年春季。在此期间，中国政府的审批进程一直让苹果难以掌握进展。

title: 字节跳动据称拟为旗下数据中心 洽购联发科定制晶片
content_preview: 中国大陆科技巨企字节跳动据称拟为旗下数据中心，洽购台湾晶片设计巨企联发科的定制晶片。 彭博社星期四（10月15日）引述知情人士，报道上述消息。报道称，字节跳动即将就采购联发科的定制晶片达成协议。 知情者称，联发科将提供不定额数量的专用集成电路（ASIC），或根据客户平台需求定制的晶片。如果交易达成，字节跳动可能成为继Alphabet旗下谷歌之后，联发科此类ASIC的第二家主要客户。 字节跳动正在加大硬件支出，押注人工智能（AI）成为其下一个增长引擎。但与阿里巴巴集团和腾讯控股等中国竞争对手一样，字节跳动无法获得英伟达等美国科企最尖端的AI晶片。华为等中国本土科技企业则无法满足全部需求。 字节跳动方暂未对此事发表评论，联发科代表则拒予置评。 路透社6月引述知情人士称，美国晶片巨头高通正与字节跳动洽谈，为后者提供晶片设计服务。随着智能手机市场增长放缓，高通正加快业务多元化布局，寻求降低对手机业务这一最大收入来源的依赖。
